### ✅ Proven - Leaderboard Stage-0 PASSED: retail usermap LUI CAN write files (2026-07-11)

- **Result:** retail Steam BO3 LUI (from a plain Workshop usermap, no client mods) **can read/write
  files under `players\`** — the leaderboard is buildable. Proven live (self-run via
  `steam.exe -applaunch`, zero user cost): trace `I:in|EG_function|io_table|wr_true_BCOK|done` and
  `players\acc_lb_bc.txt` exists on disk containing `BCOK`.
- **The working recipe (docs/40 "✅ THE WORKING RECIPE"; four blocks, all verified):**
  (1) **Compiler:** built `Jake-NotTheMuss/hksc` from source via a portable **w64devkit** (MinGW-w64,
  unzipped to scratch — no system install), `configure --game=t7 && make`; it has no stdlib whitelist
  and emits bytecode whose header (`1b 4c 75 61 51 0e …`) is byte-identical to MACHIN[A]'s.
  (2) **Unlock:** HavokScript locks `io`/`os` by default — the chunk calls **`EnableGlobals()`** first
  (this is why every v1–v5 probe read them as nil; read out of MACHIN[A]'s save.lua).
  (3) **Past L3akMod:** L3akMod chokes on bytecode *rawfiles* (`.luac`→bogus ERR; `.lua`+bytecode→linker
  `0xC00000FF` crash), so instead the hksc bytecode is embedded as a Lua `\ddd` **string constant**
  inside a normal source `.lua` that names only whitelist-clean globals (load/pcall/type/Engine) —
  L3akMod compiles it fine, carrying the bytecode inert.
  (4) **Load:** HKS `load` is 5.1-strict (`load(string)` throws), so `load(reader→bytecode)` undumps it
  to a callable chunk at runtime → `pcall` runs it → `EnableGlobals()` → `io.*` works.
- **Stage 2 (cloud) ALSO proven (v7):** a follow-up run added `os.execute` + curl to the chunk —
  both work with no crash (the earlier "crash" was a misdiagnosis; those runs used `load(string)`
  so the chunk never ran). `os.execute("cmd /c exit 42")` → rc **42**; **curl fetched 559 bytes of
  real HTML over HTTPS** into `players\acc_lb_http.txt` (verified on disk). So the full original
  architecture (every game → cloud DB → top-10 back in game, zero player installs) is buildable;
  Stage 2 just needs the backend + POST/GET wiring, no engine blocker.
- **Also:** sanitize anything pushed through the `Engine.Exec`→dvar telemetry bridge (strip control
  chars/quotes/`;`) — a multiline Lua traceback otherwise splatters as bogus console commands and can
  wedge the client. Toolchain (hksc.exe, w64devkit, generators) currently in scratch, not yet repo —
  see docs/40 "Productionizing". Memories: `retail-lui-io-os-persistence-and-http`,
  `l3akmod-rawfile-global-whitelist`. Files: `_acc_leaderboard.gsc`, `acc_lb_spike.lua` (v6).

### Investigated - Leaderboard spike v5 bisect: retail HKS has NO runtime source compiler (2026-07-11)

- **Outcome:** the Stage-0 io/os spike ran to a definitive dead-end after 7 total in-game runs.
  The io/os *runtime presence* question is unanswerable by our chosen method because **both
  ways to even NAME `io`/`os` in usermap LUI are blocked**: (1) in source → L3akMod's build
  whitelist rejects it (docs/19); (2) in a `load("…io…")` runtime string → **retail shipped
  HavokScript has no runtime source compiler** (`load` exists but is a bytecode-only stub:
  `load(string)` throws, `load(reader)` returns nil for source text). The `load()` dodge that
  the earlier CHANGELOG entry called the fix therefore COMPILES but is inert at runtime.
- **v5 bisect (runs 5a–5c, self-run via `steam.exe -applaunch` — the fix for the scripted-launch
  jam, so zero user cost):** 5a proved `Engine.Exec(GetLocalClientNum(), "set <dvar> …")` works
  from an `OpenLUIMenu` overlay (our Lua→dvar→GSC telemetry bridge; `SendMenuResponse` stays dead
  from overlays, and `echo` is not a T7 command); 5b/5c ran the full battery to completion with
  NO crash (v4's CTD was the `Engine.SetDvar(nil,…)`/`Exec(nil,…)` nil-controller roulette v5
  dropped) and delivered the per-stage dump above.
- **Remaining routes (user decision):** (A) precompiled **`.luac`** bytecode naming io/os —
  bypasses both blocks, is how MACHIN[A] demonstrably ships io/os, but needs an HKS-compatible
  `luac` (reverse-engineering a toolchain); (B) **Plan B companion app** (out via console_mp.log
  `[SCRIPTER]` lines, in via launch dvars — needs players to run a helper); (C) park it.
- Spike stays live + dev-gated but inert-by-outcome (reports S1=NO/S2=NO). Full ledger + fork:
  docs/40 "THE FINDING"; memories `l3akmod-rawfile-global-whitelist`,
  `retail-lui-io-os-persistence-and-http`. Files: `_acc_leaderboard.gsc`, `acc_lb_spike.lua`.

### Fixed - Fire Bow charge move rebuilt as a CUSTOM system: script-owned hold detection + guaranteed portal (user, 2026-07-11, 6th charge report)

- **"This is the 6th time we tried to fix this... I genuinely think we need a custom solution."** Granted.
  Root pattern across ALL prior failures: the charge move rode a fragile ENGINE chain — hold → engine
  charge levels 1..4 → release fires that level's weapon def → def must be `elemental_bow_demongate4` →
  its projectile must notify `projectile_impact` → portal. Three of the five prior root causes were that
  chain silently breaking (full-charge threshold dvar 2026-07-07, `SetWeaponAmmoClip` writes mid-draw
  resetting the charge 2026-07-08, watchers dead after bleed-out 2026-07-08), any future mid-draw
  weapon-state poke re-breaks it invisibly, and a direct zombie-BODY hit can eat the `projectile_impact`
  event entirely — matching the standing report "charge does nothing **when zombies are near**" while
  floor taps chomper fine.
- **The custom system (`_zm_weap_elemental_bow_demongate.gsc`, all per-player threads endon-disconnect
  only so they survive death):**
  1. `acc_firebow_hold_tracker` — polls `AttackButtonPressed()` while the bow is held and keeps the
     trigger-press START time on the player. Our own clock; immune to engine charge resets.
  2. `acc_firebow_fire_watcher` — on every bow `missile_fire`, hold time = now − press start (read at the
     event, dodging the 50ms poll race; a just-finished hold is parked for 300ms as a fallback read).
     Hold ≥ **`acc_firebow_charge_hold_ms`** (default **1200**, live-tunable; GDT full draw =
     `chargeShotMaxTime 0.8` × levels) OR the def is `..4` ⇒ the arrow is CHARGED: mark the projectile
     (`acc_fb_charged_proj`) and shadow it with `acc_firebow_charged_proj_tracker`.
  3. `bow_demongate_impact_explosion` now opens the **portal for a marked arrow no matter which def the
     engine fired** (partial `..demongate/2/3` included); unmarked arrows keep the tap-chomper branch.
  4. If the impact event never arrives, the shadow tracker (polls the projectile entity to end-of-life,
     4s cap) opens the portal at the arrow's **last tracked origin** — a full draw ALWAYS produces the
     move. `acc_firebow_portal_gate_open()` (500ms per-shooter) guarantees one portal per arrow across
     both paths.
  Engine full charge still works and still costs its native 2 arrows (+1 portal deduction unchanged);
  the custom path only ADDS portals the engine wrongly withheld. The dev panel's `FIRED` line now shows
  `hold=<ms>` + which authority armed the portal (`ENGINE FULL` / `CUSTOM FULL` / `tap`), and a
  `FALLBACK portal` line marks the no-impact-event rescue.
- **Balance note (unchanged, but worth knowing while testing):** at PaP tier 0 the void ring is
  deliberately small (radius 50 ≈ 1.3 m, 20% round-HP/s) — a zombie walking through takes 1–2 ticks. If
  a working tier-0 void still *feels* like nothing, that's the designed nerf ladder
  (`acc_firebow_aoe_radius_t0..3`), not the bug.
- docs/25 (generator) updated; memory `hb21-elemental-bows-integration` updated.

### Fixed - Zombies grinding on props: navmesh cut under all prop/box clips (user, 2026-07-11)

- **User report:** zombies randomly get stuck ON objects, trying to walk through them until
  the player moves to an open area — "their target line is thinner than their own model."
- **Root cause (3-track research: repo audit + stock mirror + web/install):** cod2map64's
  navmesh generator IGNORES entities (`radiant\configs\navmesh.json` `exclusions`:
  misc_model/script_model/script_brushmodel/dyn_model), so all 30 `acc_clip_*` +
  6 `acc_box_clip_*` **script_brushmodel** prop clips (tools/add_prop_clips.js
  `brushmodel:true`) are collision the pathfinder can't see — the mesh runs straight
  through every station/cache/bench/jukebox/ATM footprint. Zombies path onto it, grind on
  the invisible clip, and never reroute (stock `factory_closest_player` only re-picks an
  INVALID target, never a merely-unreachable one; the only stock recovery is the 30s
  round_spawn_failsafe suicide). NOT a stale navmesh — the 07-11 build regenerated it; the
  problem is structural. The clips were made script_brushmodel deliberately (LED-exempt,
  dodges brush.cpp:1860) — the same property that makes them navmesh-exempt. Only the 3
  worldspawn clips (exo_station/reactor_plinth/perk_slot_vendor) were already correct.
- **Fix (stock pattern — every perk machine/PaP does this, `_zm_perks.gsc:1551-1555`,
  `_zm_pack_a_punch.gsc:114-118`):** `_acc_map_randomizer.gsc::manage_prop_clip_navmesh` —
  one-shot `DisconnectPaths()` sweep over every script_brushmodel whose targetname carries
  `acc_clip_`/`acc_box_clip_` (prefix-based, so future add_prop_clips.js clips are covered
  automatically); plus `disconnectpaths()` on the Paradise Box script_model at spawn
  (`_acc_glitch_altar.gsc` — its `der_magic_box` model self-collides via `_col` LOD, same
  blindness). DYNAMICPATH spawnflag trap ruled out: our door slabs/lockdown seal already
  Connect/DisconnectPaths these .map brushmodels live. **RULE going forward:** these clips
  are permanently solid so one-shot is correct — any future NotSolid() on one MUST pair a
  ConnectPaths() (like _acc_perk_doors / the lockdown seal).
- Ledger: docs/16 "Navmesh ignores ALL entity collision — script-placed props need
  DisconnectPaths()"; KB navmesh gotcha updated; memory
  `navmesh-excludes-entities-disconnectpaths`.

### Added - Leaderboard STAGE-0 spike + L3akMod global-whitelist discovery (user "go ahead", 2026-07-11)

- **RUNTIME FIX after live run 1 (UI Error 52112, 2026-07-11 13:40):** harvest showed GSC's
  "opening probe menu" then SILENCE — the Lua died on its FIRST `load(body)` call. Cause:
  **HKS is 5.1-strict — `load()` takes a reader FUNCTION; passing a string THROWS** ("bad
  argument #1"), and the call wasn't pcall'd. Fix: `Compile()` tries both dialects
  (`pcall(load, string)` then the 5.1 `load(readerfn)` form), everything pcall-wrapped, the
  whole probe pass pcall'd (internal errors render+report as a line instead of UI-erroring),
  plus a GSC 10s watchdog that logs "no Lua response" to console_mp.log so a silent Lua death
  is self-diagnosing in the next harvest.
- **Self-logging + one-command harvest (user follow-up: "log things yourself so we can see"):**
  the spike reports on FOUR channels with zero manual transcription — (1) the Lua appends its
  FULL timestamped report to `players\acc_lb_spike_report.txt` (via the io under test); (2)
  EVERY report line rides `SendMenuResponse` → GSC `IPrintLnBold` → **`console_mp.log`**
  `[ SCRIPTER]` lines (the durable engine log — and confirmed live 2026-07-11 that
  `games_mp.log`/`LogPrint` NEVER materializes on this box despite `+set g_log`, validating
  the apex-pack memory; console_mp.log is the log of record); (3) on-screen teal lines; (4)
  the probe artifacts. **`tools/read_lb_spike.ps1`** (new) reads all four channels post-run
  and prints the VERDICT — agents read results themselves; the user just plays.
- **What:** the docs/40 Stage-0 gate, built. `_acc_leaderboard.gsc` (new module, wired into
  `_acc_main` + zone + entry `.csc` LuiLoad) opens `ui/uieditor/menus/hud/acc_lb_spike.lua`
  per player ~2s after blackscreen, **dev mode only** (`IS_TRUE(level.acc_dev)`; ship builds
  never open it). Probes: lib presence (`io`/`os`/`os.execute`/`os.time`/`io.popen`), a
  `players/` file write+read-back (per-run token), side-effect-free exec (`cmd /c exit 42` →
  rc 42), and HTTP (`os.execute` curl `-m 6` → `io`-read the output). Reports on 3 channels:
  on-screen teal text, `SendMenuResponse("AccLbSpike", …)` mirrored by GSC to `IPrintLnBold`
  + `LogPrint("ACCLB_SPIKE;…")` (games_mp.log), and artifacts `players\acc_lb_spike_*.txt`.
  Final line = verdict `Stage1 GO/NO · Stage2 GO/PARTIAL/NO`.
- **THE DISCOVERY (build blocker, root-caused live):** naming `io`/`os` directly in rawfile
  Lua **fails the build** — L3akMod's rawfile compiler has a **link-time global whitelist**
  and rejects `io`/`os`/`_G`/`getfenv`/`loadstring`/`rawget`, surfacing as the *misleading*
  `[L3akMod (D3V)] Error: attempt to index global 'ERR' (a nil value)` + linker exit -1 + no
  fresh `.ff`. Bisected with single-construct probe files (`type(pcall)` builds, `type(io)`
  does not) via direct linker A/B runs. This is a COMPILE block, separate from the runtime
  question. **Fix (proven to compile, shipped in the spike):** reach `io`/`os` through
  `load("… io …")` — a string chunk the HKS VM compiles at *runtime*, dodging the whitelist
  (`load` is whitelisted; the string is data). Spike now **builds clean** (fresh `.ff`,
  BUILD OK); awaits the in-game dev run for the runtime half. Portable write-up: docs/19
  §"BUILD GOTCHA: L3akMod rejects non-whitelisted GLOBALS"; memory
  `l3akmod-rawfile-global-whitelist`. Consequence: all Stage 1/2 `io`/`os` calls use the
  `load()` dodge (or ship `.luac`). Files: `_acc_leaderboard.gsc`, `acc_lb_spike.lua`,
  `_acc_main.gsc`, `zm_abandoned_cyber_city.csc`, `.zone`, docs/19, docs/40.

### Changed - Panzer hit-location tuning: body 10% → 35%, real headshot bonus, head no longer helmet-gated (user, 2026-07-11)

- **Report:** the Panzer feels like a pure bullet sponge — "so much health, more noticeable because he
  has no headshot weakness" — and "some guns can't headshot; only PaP'd guns?" Diagnosis: he runs the
  stock `MechzServerUtils::mechzDamageCallback` (not the normal-zombie damage path), which scales hits
  by body part — **head 100%, exposed power core 100%, torso/limbs 10%** (`MECHZ_BODY_DAMAGE_SCALE 0.1`),
  explosives 50%. Two things fell out of that: (1) body was a 10% sponge and the head does *base* (not a
  *bonus*) so it never "popped"; (2) the head weak spot is **gated behind the faceplate**, and our
  faceplate is a fat pool (`level.var_fa14536d` 1500+ scaling toward a 16000 cap, vs **stock's 50**), so
  a weak gun (the reported non-PaP Grav / `t9_grav`, a bullet AR) can never break the helmet to expose
  the head → reads as "only PaP guns can headshot." It's the helmet, not PaP.
- **Fix:** the stock scales/gate live in stock code we can't edit, so we WRAP `actor_damage_func`
  (`acc_boss_panzer::acc_mechz_damage_wrap`, **bullet-only** — splash/explosive/projectile MODs keep
  their dedicated stock handling). It delegates to stock first (preserving ALL side effects — part
  destruction, faceplate/powercap tracking, hit markers, pain audio, scoring, explosive reaction), then:
  - **Body rebuff:** recovers the pure stock hit scale (result ÷ weapon-modified base, mirror of
    `mechzWeaponDamageModifier`) and multiplies ONLY the 0.1 family up to `acc_panzer_body_scale`
    (**default 0.35**, ×3.5). Exposed-core (0.5/1.0) left stock. Body-only TTK drops ~3.5×.
  - **Headshot, un-gated:** a face hit (engine `"head"` hitLoc **or** height-guarded proximity to the
    `j_faceplate` tag, `acc_panzer_head_radius` 21u — 18 → 21 (+~15%) same day, felt too tight) now
    pays `acc_panzer_head_scale` (**default 1.25×
    base ≈ 3.6× a body shot**) for **every bullet, faceplate or not** — so any gun can headshot. Stock
    still chips the faceplate, so the helmet visually breaks; it's just no longer a hard gate.
- **Flamethrower +20% (same day):** stock burn constants (`MECHZ_FT_PLAYER_DAMAGE` 30 / 20 with Jugg,
  0.5s ticks over a 1.5s burn) live inside stock `MechzBehavior::playerFlameDamage` — the vendored
  flame loop (`mechz_spiki.gsc`) now calls `acc_player_flame_damage`, a scaled twin (same `is_burning`
  mutex + Jugg branch + `burnplayer::SetPlayerBurning`) with per-tick damage × `acc_panzer_flame_mult`
  (default **1.2** → 36 / 24 with Jugg).
- Panzer is the only mechz on the map, so nothing else is affected. Restore exact stock:
  `acc_panzer_body_scale 0.1`, `acc_panzer_head_scale 1.0`, `acc_panzer_flame_mult 1.0`.
  Files: `_acc_boss_panzer.gsc`, `mechz_spiki.gsc`, docs/08.

### Fixed - Co-op "instant reset while reviving" = stock OOB monitor instant-kill in a zone-coverage gap (user, 2026-07-11)

- **Report:** in co-op a player revived a teammate in the Lab, swung the Leviathan axe for a couple of
  seconds getting kills, then **INSTANTLY reset** — all guns replaced by the start pistol, all money gone,
  no last stand. Not the axe, not Berzerker (they had neither): the trigger is the stock
  `player_out_of_playable_area_monitor` ([`_zm.gsc:2035+`](tmp/bo3_stock_ref/scripts/zm/_zm.gsc#L2035)),
  which hard-kills — `DisableInvulnerability(); lives = 0; DoDamage(self.health + 1000); bleedout_time = 0`
  (= **instant** bleed-out) — any player its **~3s poll** finds outside every enabled `player_volume`. That
  instant `bled_out` fires our Comeback respawn ([`_acc_points::on_player_spawned`](scripts/zm/zm_abandoned_cyber_city/_acc_points.gsc#L175)):
  the start pistol is the vanilla co-op death respawn, and the money is Comeback SETTING it to 500×round.
  **A revive pins you standing next to the downed body** — so if that body fell in a zone-coverage gap, the
  poll catches the stationary reviver a couple seconds later. Forensics: the money-wipe has exactly ONE
  source in the entire script tree (Comeback, gated on `bled_out`).
- **Fix — [`_acc_bus_trench::acc_trench_oob_allow`](scripts/zm/zm_abandoned_cyber_city/_acc_bus_trench.gsc) (GSC-only):**
  - **Grace:** the kill is now vetoed until the player has been CONTINUOUSLY outside the volumes for
    `acc_oob_grace_ms` (default 12000ms / ~4 polls). A reviver is OOB for ~one poll and is spared; a
    genuinely escaped/noclipped player stays OOB for many polls and is still culled. Makes the instant-reset
    impossible without disabling the stock escape-hatch entirely.
  - **Diagnostic:** on the first tick of any surface OOB episode it prints the exact origin to all players
    (`acc_oob_debug`, default 1, **TEMPORARY**) so the specific geometry gap can be found and closed by
    extending the `player_volume`. Same bug class as the 2026-06-18 trench OOB fix, now recurring on the
    surface. Memory: `oob-monitor-instant-reset-in-zone-gap`.

### Fixed - Armory weapon rack: racked gun jutted through the narrow cabinet (user, 2026-07-11)

- **"The UI for the Armory needs to be looked at, especially when you're placing the gun inside the

  laying it **across** the cabinet. But the cabinet mesh (`p7_con_cargo_train_armory_cabinet`) is only
  **18u deep** (Y) though **138u long** (X) — bounds `min(-68.9,-9.0,-0.2) max(68.9,9.0,48.0)`,
  VERIFIED via `tools/xmodel_bin_inspect`. A ~50u rifle laid across an 18u-deep cabinet juts ~15u out
  of **both** narrow faces — the gun visibly sticks *through* the holder.
- **Fix:** a single racked gun now lies **along** the cabinet's long X axis (yaw 0) so it rests
  lengthwise like a rifle on a rack; a raised `acc_armory_rack_max` still fans guns into a
  side-by-side row (default yaw is cap-aware). The gun angle (`acc_armory_rack_yaw` / `_pitch` /
  `_roll`) and float height (`acc_armory_rack_hover`, default 6u above the +48 top face) are now
  **live-tunable dvars** so the exact lie can be dialed in-game without a rebuild. Cabinet origin is

  docs/39 + docs/22 updated. GSC-only (linker-only), fresh `.ff` packed 2026-07-11.

### Fixed - Fire Bow void could not damage zombies: DoT radius measured 3D from an elevated center (user, 2026-07-11)

- **"The charge move is supposed to kill zombies around the void it spawns but it doesn't."** The
  portal opened, the DoT ticker ran, and yet nothing near the void ever took damage. Root cause is
  pure geometry ([`_zm_weap_elemental_bow_demongate.gsc`](scripts/zm/_zm_weap_elemental_bow_demongate.gsc)
  `::bow_demongate_portal_dot`): `bow_demongate_get_impact_pos` places the portal center **~64 units
  above the floor** (`+normal[2]×64` on floor hits, floor-snap`+64` on wall hits), while a zombie's
  origin is at its **feet** — and the tick sweep tested `Distance( z.origin, v_pos ) > radius` in
  **3D**. At tier-0 radius 50 that inequality has **no solution at ground level**
  (`sqrt(h²+64²) > 50` for every horizontal `h`), so the un-PaP'd void *mathematically could not
  damage any standing zombie*; tier 1 (r=65) reached only ~11u of real floor, tiers 2/3 (r=80/95)
  only 48/70u. The same elevated-center-vs-feet geometry is why the pack's original `radiusDamage`
  kill "provably lands zero damage on this map" (2026-07-08 note) — the whole feature has been dead
  zone'd since integration, through every previous root-cause fix (watcher death, clip-clamp charge
  reset, silent ticker crash).
- **Fix:** the radius is now a **horizontal ring** — `Distance2D( z.origin, v_pos )` vs the tier
  radius — with the height gated separately by a same-floor window
  (`abs(dz) <= acc_firebow_dot_zband`, default 160: clears the 64u portal lift + crawlers/ramps,
  excludes zombies a storey away). Bonus fix in the same tick: per-tick damage now **ceils** instead
  of `int()`-flooring (5 × `int(0.20×953)` = 950 left a 3-HP sliver — a zombie could ride out the
  entire tier-0 portal and survive; now N full ticks always finish the kill). docs/25 regenerated via
  `gen_weapon_stats.js` (radius documented as horizontal + the new zband dvar). GSC-only
  (linker-only) change — no geometry, no LED bake.

### Fixed - Mule Kick overhaul: sticky at-risk slot + transaction freeze + box double-draw (user, 2026-07-11)

Full audit of the Mule Kick at-risk-gun system after three user reports: (1) "the mule kick gun keeps
re-attaching to the last gun I buy — replacing a NON-mule gun made the new gun the mule gun"; (2) "I
PaP'd my mule kick gun and another gun became the mule kick gun"; (3) "a gun I pull from the box gets
drawn twice for no reason".

- **STICKY SLOT semantics** ([`_acc_gun_badges.gsc`](scripts/zm/zm_abandoned_cyber_city/_acc_gun_badges.gsc)):
  the 2026-07-08 design defined the at-risk gun as the **tail of the acquisition order** (last-acquired),
  so *every* new acquisition (box, wallbuy, rack withdrawal) stole the designation — report (1) by
  construction. New rule (user spec): **the gun that fills the 3rd slot IS the Mule Kick gun until that
  specific gun leaves the loadout** — replace it and its replacement inherits; go down and it's taken +
  cleared. New per-player field `acc_mule_at_risk` (a `true_base` identity, so twins/PaP forms never move
  it), designated at the order tail only when unset or when the designated gun is genuinely absent from
  the loadout (presence-checked, NOT count-checked — a mid-replace count dip can't move it). Badge
  (`pred_mule`) and the laststand take (`acc_mule_on_laststand`) both read the same designation; the
  laststand loop re-resolves per pass (4+ gun states take down to 2, stock-style) and clears the sticky.
- **TRANSACTION FREEZE** (`mule_state_frozen`): root cause of report (2) — `replay_pack_draw`
  (PaP tier 2→3, `_acc_pap_levels`) **takes EVERY primary**, dwells 2 empty-handed frames, and re-gives
  in ENGINE order; the 0.25s badge poll landing in that window rebuilt `acc_mule_order` in re-give order
  and jumped the designation to another gun. The order + designation are now frozen (no reconcile) while
  `acc_pap_busy` (held across the whole replay) / `acc_box_grabbing` / `is_drinking` (replay increments
  it too) are set — state resolves on the first settled tick. The laststand take passes `force=true`
  (a down must still remove a gun even mid-drink, stock parity).
- **Box-grab settle rewritten** (report (3), [`_acc_weapon_variants.gsc`](scripts/zm/zm_abandoned_cyber_city/_acc_weapon_variants.gsc)):
  `box_grab_defer_watcher`'s old settle ("one `weapon_change_complete` OR 1.0s") was porous both ways —
  the at-limit give's take-churn can fire an EARLY `weapon_change_complete` while the grabbed gun is
  still rising, and slow-raise guns blow through 1.0s. Either way the deferred Mega-twin reconcile ran
  MID-RAISE: `was_equipped` false vs the transitional old gun → took the in-flight switch target with no
  re-switch → the engine re-drew the twin from scratch = the visible double draw. New shared
  `wait_box_give_settled()`: polls until `GetCurrentWeapon()` has *changed from its at-grab value* and
  held stable 2 consecutive ticks (3s cap). `_acc_pap_levels::box_grab_clear_watcher` had the same porous
  settle (could read the OLD gun mid-raise → miss the tier clear → stale PaP tier on a re-boxed gun) and
  now uses the same helper.
- **Audit coverage** (all traced clean under the new rules): box 2→3 / at-limit replace of mule + non-mule
  gun, wallbuy give + ammo re-buy, PaP tier 1→2 transform (give-then-take, no gap), tier 2→3 replay
  (frozen), Action Figure ladder packs, variant/Mega twin swaps (identity-invariant), mega drink replay,
  armory rack deposit/withdraw, laststand incl. 4-gun states + `_retain_perks`, post-revive stale-sticky
  self-heal. GSC-only change (linker-only build).

### Fixed - Perk-door permanent-unlock prompt showed a blank "Weapon" card (user, 2026-07-11)

- **The "pay 2 Mega Bottles to open this perk door forever" trigger showed a blank Mystery-Box
  WEAPON card** instead of a readable prompt. Root cause in the LUI cursor-hint router
  ([`ZMCursorHintNew.lua`](ui/uieditor/widgets/HUD/ZM_CursorHint/ZMCursorHintNew.lua)): the unlock
  hint reads `Hold [{+activate}] Open <perk> permanently for N Mega Bottles`
  (`_acc_perk_doors::unlock_hint`). A 2026-07-10 fix already guarded `getPerkFromHint` against the
  word `permanently` (so it stopped mis-routing to the perk BUY card), **but the same guard was
  missing from `isMysteryBoxWeapon`** — that classifier is a loose "`hold` + `for`, no
  buy/cost/mystery keyword" catch-all, so it grabbed the hint next, and `getWeaponFromHint` took the
  text after `" for "` and tried to render a weapon literally named **"N Mega Bottles"** → the blank
  Weapon card.
- **Fix:** `isMysteryBoxWeapon` now bails on `permanently`/`bottle` (unique to Mega-Bottle
  transactions, never a box weapon), mirroring the `getPerkFromHint` guard. The hint now falls
  through to the plain **DefaultHint**, which shows the readable unlock text. LUI-only
  (linker/`-GscOnly`) change — no geometry, no LED bake.

### Fixed - Fire Sale now shows/charges 10 at the Mystery Box (was still 950) (user, 2026-07-11)

- **The Mystery Box kept showing the base **950** during a Fire Sale instead of the stock **$10**
  sale price.** Root cause: our box prompt hook
  ([`_acc_perk_info.gsc`](scripts/zm/zm_abandoned_cyber_city/_acc_perk_info.gsc)`::acc_box_prompt`)
  is the **authoritative per-frame writer** of `box.zombie_cost` (that's how the Armory 10%-off box
  discount works — `armory_box_pricing`), and during a Fire Sale it *skipped* and relied on stock
  `_zm_powerup_fire_sale::toggle_fire_sale_on()` having set the chest to 10. On this map (single
  roaming box, 6 nodes) that 10 didn't survive on the box the player actually uses, so the hint +
  charge read the base cost.
- **Fix:** `acc_box_prompt` now **owns the sale price** — while `box_firesale_active()`, it forces
  `box.zombie_cost = 10` itself (capturing the real cost into `old_cost` first, then the existing
  non-sale branch restores that price the instant the sale ends). No Armory discount stacks on the
  10-point sale (a 10% cut would round to free). Display and charge both read the same field, so both
  are 10 during the sale. GSC-only (linker-only) change — no geometry, no LED bake.
- **Note:** the separate **Paradise Box** (`_acc_glitch_altar.gsc`, an independent GSC interactable
  that deliberately never touches `_zm_magicbox`/`level.chests`) does NOT participate in Fire Sale by
  design and still charges `acc_paradise_box_cost` (950).

### Fixed - Blast-O-Matic + Thundergun PaP reserve collapsed to 6 (`ammoCountClipRelative` trap) (user, 2026-07-10)

- **Blast-O-Matic PaP (`_up`) showed only 6 reserve.** Root cause: the `t9_semiauto_cosplay_up` block is
  authored **`ammoCountClipRelative "0"`** = `maxAmmo`/`startAmmo` are **ABSOLUTE ROUNDS**, but the 2026-07-09
  `blasto_ammo_mors_ft_0709.js` oneshot assumed the normal magazine model (`reserve = maxAmmo × clipSize`) and
  cut `maxAmmo`/`startAmmo` `110 → 6` believing it meant `6 × 20 = 120` rounds — under clipRel-0 that set the
  literal reserve to **6**. The base form (`t9_semiauto_cosplay`, clipRel `1`, `maxAmmo 12 × clip 5 = 60`) was
  fine, which is why only the PaP looked wrong.
- **Thundergun had the identical bug.** The same-day `thundergun_ammo_0709.js` cut `thundergun_zm` / `thundergun_upgraded_zm`
  `maxAmmo`/`startAmmo` `12/24 → 6`, again mis-reading clipRel-0 rounds as magazines → in-game reserve **6** instead
  of the stock **12 (base) / 24 (Zeus)**.
- **Full-roster audit** (scratchpad `audit_reserve.js`, honors `ammoCountClipRelative`): these two wonder weapons +
  their PaP twins were the ONLY active guns with a broken reserve. Bows / Leviathan Axe / Action Figure are clipRel-0
  with 0 reserve **by design** (regen/melee specials); PDW & M1911 akimbos are REMOVED; every other gun is clipRel-1
  and correct.
- **Fix** ([`tools/oneshots/fix_reserve_cliprel_0710.js`](tools/oneshots/fix_reserve_cliprel_0710.js)): restore the
  porter/stock ROUND counts (clipRel stays `0`) on the packed/upgraded blocks **and their perk twins** (repo +
  install GDTs): **Blast-O-Matic `_up` + 3 twins → 110**; **Thundergun base + fastreload twin → 12**, **upgraded +
  twin → 24**. `gdtdb /update` + `-GscOnly` relink (fresh `.ff` verified).
- **Guardrails against recurrence:** `tools/gen_weapon_stats.js` now honors `ammoCountClipRelative` (was hardcoding
  `reserve = clip × maxAmmo`, which mis-reported the wonder reserves) and its `OUT` path corrected `41 → 25` (renumber
  oversight); docs/25 regenerated (Blast-O-Matic reserve `120 → 110`). The misleading "maxAmmo = MAGAZINES" universal
  claim corrected in [docs/04](docs/04_weapons.md) and the `reduce_base_ammo.js` header.

### Fixed - Perk display UI audit: Mega "$1" cost + stale descriptions (user, 2026-07-10)

- **Mega buy prompt showed "$1" (gold Points) instead of "1 Mega Bottle".** The Aetherium cursor-hint
  perk card (`PromptPerks.lua::UpdatePerkInfo`) chose base-vs-mega purely from the async `accOwnedMask`,
  which lags the buy by up to 0.25s (`perk_state_watch` poll). In that window a Mega machine hint fell to
  the BASE branch, whose cost regex `Cost:%s*(%d+)` scraped the **"1"** out of `[Cost: 1 Mega Bottle]` and
  painted a gold "1" with the essence/Points icon. Fix: the card now reads the LIVE machine hint and, when
  it contains the literal `Cost: 1 Mega Bottle` (unique to `_acc_mega_bottles::mega_trigger_think`; the
  perk-door unlock reads "for 2 Mega Bottles"), forces the Mega-PREVIEW branch → teal "1 Mega Bottle".
  Root-caused + adversarially verified via a multi-agent audit of every perk display surface.
- **Stale/wrong Mega descriptions in `AetheriumPerks.lua` (the live buy-prompt data):**
  - **Double Tap → Gun Slinger** advertised "Shoots even faster / Swap weapons faster", but the 2026-07-04
    rework removed the fire-rate/weapon-swap twin — Mega DT is now damage-only. Now reads "Extra bullets
    hit harder" (matches `acc_hud.lua` + `_acc_damage`/`_acc_mega_bottles`). Base name also synced
    "DOUBLE TAP" → "DOUBLE TAP 2.0" to match the info card + spec (routing unaffected).
  - **Quick Revive → Savior** "Faster near allies" invented a proximity aura; the +15% only triggers while
    a teammate is DOWNED (any distance). Now "Faster when an ally is down".
  - **PhD Flopper → PhD Slider** "Bigger explosions" was backwards (the Mega nova is 250u vs base 300u,
    hit-capped + damage-frozen) and omitted the real Mega perk. Now "More explosive damage" (+15%).
  - Same three corrections mirrored in the retired-but-sync-mandated `acc_hud.lua` `AccPerkCards` table.
- **Electric Cherry + PhD Flopper machine hints baked the cost as a literal** with `&&1` reserved for the
  button, so `_acc_perk_info::armory_perk_pricing` couldn't substitute the Armory 10%-off price on the wall
  (an Armory holder was charged the discount but the wall/prompt still read full price). Switched both to
  the documented recipe (docs/16) `"Hold ^3[{+activate}]^7 for X [Cost: &&1]"` — `[{+activate}]` = use key,
  `&&1` = cost substitution — so they behave like the 8 stock perks. **Verify the hint renders in-game.**
- **Permanent perk-door unlock trigger routed to the perk BUY card.** Its hint ("Open <perk> permanently
  for N Mega Bottles") contains a perk name + "for", so the cursor-hint router word-matched it as a perk
  prompt. Added a `"permanently"` guard in `ZMCursorHintNew::getPerkFromHint` so it falls through to the
  plain readable DefaultHint.
- Docs reconciled to the shipped code: `docs/perk_abilities.md` + `docs/13_perks.md` still listed the Mega
  Spiderman one-hit melee (removed 2026-06-29) as active/OK — marked REMOVED.
- **GSC/`.csc`/`.lua`-only + docs change → linker-only build (`-GscOnly`), no LED bake needed.**

### Fixed - Avogadro no-item-drop + Mystery Box gun-swap (user, 2026-07-10)

- **Avogadro dropped no item.** `_acc_boss_avogadro::boss_life()` sampled the drop origin with a bare
  `while ( isdefined(boss) && isalive(boss) )` poll. The pack's `death()` sets `boss.is_alive=0` **at
  ground**, then `AnimScripted("exit_anim")` lifts him ~800u while `allowdeath` stays false — so
  `.health` is held and engine `isalive()` stays TRUE through the whole departure rise. The poll kept
  re-sampling `boss.origin` **airborne**, and `grant_drops`' floor-snap (2500u down-trace) then missed /
  snapped onto the roof → the item spawned unreachable. Fix: break the poll on the pack's own
  `boss.is_alive==0` flag (set at ground before the rise) so the retained origin is the ground kill spot;
  `wait 0.25`→`0.1` keeps it fresh. Root cause confirmed by adversarial verification. (Same class of
  airborne-drop bug the `drop_floor_origin` rework addressed for grounded corpses — but the rise puts the
  *origin* itself out of trace range, so it must be fixed at the capture site.)
- **Mystery Box: the gun you pull out ≠ the gun you keep** (surfaces with Mule Kick + a Mega perk).
  The box's slow `SwitchToWeapon` is transitional; it wakes `_acc_weapon_variants::variant_manager` mid-
  grab, and `reconcile()` captures a stale `GetCurrentWeapon()`. With a Mega token active it swaps the
  grabbed base to its twin: `GiveWeapon(twin)` + unconditional `TakeWeapon(base)` but the
  `SwitchToWeaponImmediate` is gated on `was_equipped` (false against the stale current weapon) → the
  box's pending switch target is removed with no re-switch → the view reverts to the previously-held gun
  (twin is correct in inventory). Fix: `box_grab_defer_watcher` sets `acc_box_grabbing` on the stock
  `user_grabbed_weapon` notify and clears it once the give settles (`weapon_change_complete` / 1s net),
  and `reconcile()` early-returns while it's set — mirroring the existing `is_drinking` guard and the
  proven `_acc_pap_levels::box_grab_clear_watcher`. The twin swap still happens, invisibly, once settled.

### Fixed - Every-run native CTD (exe+0x22c8f03): zbarriers PaP model swap with BLANKED board anims (2026-07-10)

- **Every local build since 2026-07-09 16:10 crashed to desktop 40-60s into active play** (2-3 min idle) with
  an engine minidump at `blackops3.exe+0x22c8f03` (`movzx esi, word ptr [rbx+42h]`, rbx=NULL, stack smashed).
  **Root cause: the 2026-07-09 07:45 edit to install-side `source_data/zbarriers.gdt`** swapped the
  Pack-a-Punch zbarrier's `boardModel1/2/5` from stock `p7_zm_vending_packapunch*` to the ALXS CW model
  `p9_fxanim_zm_gp_pap_xmodel*` while **blanking the matching `boardAnim1/2/5` slots** — the engine
  null-derefs walking the board table once barrier state churns (zombies active), a delayed asset-data crash
  invisible to the linker. **Fix: `zbarriers.gdt` reverted to the stock p7 entry** (pre-swap backup
  `zbarriers.gdt.acc-orig`; the crashing version preserved as `zbarriers.gdt.acc-bisect-now`). The CW PaP
  machine re-skin must be REDONE without touching zbarrier board slots (or with anims filled for every model
  slot) — the machine model swap does not belong in `zbarriers.gdt`.
- **Why it resisted a day of bisecting**: the poison was INSTALL-side (baked into every fresh `.ff` from the
  gdtDB), so fourteen repo-content reverts — stations, War Machine, all 7/9 GDT weapon tuning, badge
  push+widget, dev-only paths, mb/exo clientfields, full geometry recompile, a complete rollback to the last
  commit, WAV formats, sound banks, fresh config, bare usermap layout, Workshop dual-install — all still
  crashed. The decisive split: the **published Workshop artifact (built 2026-07-08 21:40, pre-swap) ran 6+ min
  clean from the local path** while every fresh compile died → poison is in the build inputs, not the machine
  or the repo. `source_data` mtime sweep of the after-publish window → zbarriers.gsc was the only un-reverted
  core edit → single-variable revert on the FULL map → two clean runs. Debug workflow notes + the full
  elimination matrix: memory `crash-hunt-2026-07-10-state`.
- **Also found, needs owner attention**: `mechz_aim` (aimtable) is defined in BOTH `mechz_spiki.gdt` (7/9)
  and `mechz_spiki_anims.gdt` (7/8) — gdtdb is same-name-wins, so one silently shadows the other; and
  `mechz_spiki_anims.gdt` carries 3 self-duplicated scriptbundles. Dedupe when next touching the Panzer pack.
- Diagnostic breadcrumbs added during the hunt were removed; the `mock_party_feed` clientfield change-guard
  (dev-mode fake-teammate HUD loop no longer writes 12 constant fields/sec) is kept as a real improvement.

### Fixed - Asset-portability overhaul: custom (non-pack) assets now git-tracked + one-command machine restore (user request, 2026-07-10)

**The problem** (multi-machine workflow): small CUSTOM-authored assets — badge/OC/PaP-tier PNGs, custom
wavs, hand-written GDTs, vendored crash-fixed pack scripts, the whole Aetherium LUI suite — were either
gitignored, never `git add`ed, or existed ONLY in the Mod Tools install, so a fresh clone on another
machine silently lost them (the data-shard original art was already lost for good in the 2026-07-01
machine move). A 61-agent audit (5 auditors + adversarial verify per finding) produced 56 verified
findings; every fix below. **Rule going forward: custom-authored files ALWAYS live in git; only licensed
game-rip content stays out (private zip via `tools/external_assets_manifest.ps1`).**

- **`.gitignore` surgical split for `source_data/acc_perk_shaders/`** (was ignored WHOLESALE as "the
  Ronan pack"): now only the 31 Ronan-derived rip files are ignored by name pattern
  (`acc_perk_*.png`, `i_acc_perk_*.png`, `i_acc_powerup_*.png`, the 3 `i_acc_pap_tier*.png.acc-hexshield-orig`
  backups + the unclear-provenance `i_acc_data_shard.png.acc-128-orig`); the hand-written
  `acc_perk_shaders.gdt` (53 entries) + all 20 custom July-2026 art files (`i_acc_badge_*`,
  `i_acc_oc_tier1-10`, `i_acc_pap_tier1-3`, `i_acc_data_shard.png`, `acc_blank.png`) are **git-tracked**.
- **Install-only custom files copied INTO the repo** (each was referenced by tracked files but existed
  nowhere durable): `source_data/acc_ssi.gdt` (the map's night-sky SSI, referenced 5x by the `.map`!),
  `map_source/_prefabs/acc/{vending_weapon_upgrade_alxs,power_switch_ww2}.map` (our clone prefabs),
  `sound_assets/acc/acc_havoc_charge{,_25,_50,_75}.wav` (custom Havoc charge SFX). `source_data/
  acc_weapon_variants.gdt` refreshed from the authoritative install copy (repo was 2 MB stale, missing
  all 49 apex/thundergun/bow twin blocks; verified strict superset before overwrite).
- **~95 untracked working-tree files staged for commit**: the 40-file Aetherium LUI suite (`ui/`),
  `fonts/` (Orbitron SIL-OFL + LetterOMatic), 30+ vendored crash-fixed pack scripts (`scripts/shared/`,
  bow suite, zod robot, fury, mechz) + 5 new `_acc_` modules, 3 hand-curated sound-alias CSVs
  (`acc_apex_weapons`, `acc_round_sounds`, `_owens_weapons` — 26 hand-patched lines), `battery_zap.wav`,
  12 tools scripts (incl. `apply_pap_zbarrier_swap.ps1`, `gen_t7_carve_gdt.js`, `_panzer_stash/`), docs 59-60.
- **Manifest gaps closed** (`tools/external_assets_manifest.ps1`, 31→33 packs): NEW **Apex Weapons
  (zeroy port)** entry (was in NO transfer channel; the install-side patched GDTs incl. `acc_apex_up.gdt`
  ride it — ~~their patch scripts were scratchpad-only and are gone, the zip is the only carrier~~
  **CORRECTED by the same-day red-team pass: all patch scripts SURVIVED in session scratchpads and are
  rescued to `tools/oneshots/`** — the zip carries the patched GDT state, the scripts carry the
  regeneration logic) + NEW
  **placeholder finale music** entry (115/paradise_calm — gitignored copyrighted wavs previously in no
  channel). Paths gaps fixed on 5 packs: Elemental Bows (+4 sound dirs, 65 wavs), Apothicon Fury (+4
  `zmb\ai` dirs), Blast-O-Matic (dangling `sound_assets\_owens_weapons` → real `_bocw` + `_mg` camo
  textures), FX Library (+`t7_beams.gdt` — load-bearing for the Panzer beam! — `p7_zm_ctl_battery_
  ceramic.gdt`, 3 `texture_assets` dirs), Skye (+`acc_war_machine_twins.gdt*`).

  fresh machine/clone (env gates → unpack zip → bin patches → GDT deploys → perk-glow FX regen → sync
  → gdtdb); **`deploy_source_data.ps1`** = repo-owned GDT deploy with divergence guard (never clobbers

### Fixed - Boss zap stuns no longer stack multiplicatively on one player (user, 2026-07-09)

- **Bug:** the three boss zap slows (Phantom chain / Rogue Protector / Avogadro, -30% each, Mega Electric
  Cherry-softened to -10%) each multiplied into `recompute_move_speed` independently — a player zapped by two
  bosses at once ran at **0.49x**, all three (a Paradise pile-on) at **0.34x**: a near-stun-lock crawl.
- **Fix (v2, same day):** `_acc_utility::recompute_move_speed` takes the single **STRONGEST active boss slow**
  as the base and each **EXTRA concurrent stun adds a flat -5%** (`acc_boss_slow_stack_add` 0.05, user: "30%
  first stun, two stuns at once is 35%"): one stun **-30%**, two **-35%**, three **-40%**. Floor-clamped at a
  0.10 multiplier. Each boss's 3s window still refreshes independently — as stuns expire the count drops and
  the base falls back to the strongest one still running. Per-boss dvars unchanged.
- **v3 (same day): Mega Electric Cherry "Power Surge" prevents the stacking outright** (user: "just -10% even
  if you get double stunned") — while every active stun is Mega-softened the stack add is skipped entirely:
  a flat **-10%** no matter how many bosses zap at once. A mixed set (perk bought/lost mid-window) behaves as
  non-Mega. docs/34 (`acc_boss_slow_stack_add`, `acc_boss_slow_mega_mult`) + docs/perk_abilities synced.

### Fixed - Apothicon Fury: permanently invisible after an interrupted charge, + silent 30s deep cull (user, 2026-07-09)

- **Invisible fury:** the pack's bamf ("charge"/teleport) drives `Ghost()`+`NotSolid()` off the anim notetrack
  `FURY_BAMF_NT_START` and only restores off `FURY_BAMF_NT_STOP` (`archetype_apothicon_fury.gsc`
  `apothiconBamfOut`/`In`). The bamf notetracks also live on TRAVERSAL anims, which have **no mocomp-terminate
  safety net** — an anim interrupted between the two notetracks left the fury **permanently invisible AND
  non-solid** (unhittable, still attacking). New `[acc]` **stuck-ghost failsafe**: armed at every bamf-out,
  disarmed by bamf-in / the mocomp terminate; after 4s (longest legit ghost window is <2s) it force-restores
  `Show()`+`Solid()`+the juke clientfield. The mocomp terminate also now resets the juke clientfield (stock
  re-Shows but left the client "teleported-out" FX state stuck at 0 when the anim was cut).
- **Deep cull:** the pack threads stock `zombie_utility::round_spawn_failsafe` on every fury, which
  DoDamage-kills ANY actor below `below_world_check` (z<-1000) on its 30s tick **regardless of movement** — an
  L5-trench fury (z=-1200) was silently dying ~30s in. `spawn_fury_near` now sets `ignore_round_spawn_failsafe`
  (the flag is re-read each failsafe loop; same treatment as every deep boss).

### Fixed - Battery: a 2nd zap during the active surge no longer cancels the boost (user, 2026-07-08)

- **Bug:** after the 12s cooldown was added, a boss zap landing during the active 5s surge fell through to the
  normal slow path (because `acc_battery_ready()` was false mid-cooldown) and set a slow flag. In
  `recompute_move_speed` the still-active `acc_battery_boost` (×1.15) and the new slow (×0.70) multiplied to
  **×0.805 — a net ~20% SLOWDOWN**, so a rapid double-zap effectively removed your surge.
- **Fix:** new `acc_battery_absorb_zap()` gate in the three zap applicators. While a surge is **active**
  (`acc_battery_boost` true, the 5s window) a further zap is **absorbed** — no slow flag, boost preserved. Off
  cooldown it procs a fresh surge as before. Per the user, the **recharge window is still a vulnerability**: a
  zap after the surge has ended but before the 12s cooldown expires **slows you normally** (that path is
  unchanged). Stale "applicators skip the slow flag for a Battery holder" comment in `recompute_move_speed`
  corrected. docs/12 synced.

### Fixed - Fire Bow charge, THE ACTUAL ROOT CAUSE: the clip-cap watcher reset every long draw (user, 2026-07-08)

- **Log-proven via the new `[BOW] FIRED` probe** (console_mp.log — which DOES write on this box; the
  stale "logfile writes nothing" memory note is corrected): every charged release fired
  `elemental_bow_demongate` (level 1) or occasionally `..2` — **`..4` (the portal def) never fired ONCE
  since integration**, so `bow_demongate_open_portal` never ran and every portal-side fix was moot. The
  "void" seen on shots was the tap-chomper's own spawn-gate FX (`demongate_chomper_fx`). Root cause: the
  bow **regenerates arrows** (GDT `power_recharge_rate 0.417`), so the clip creeps past the 30-arrow cap
  and `acc_firebow_clip_watcher`'s `SetWeaponAmmoClip` clamp re-fires ~every 2.4s forever — **an ammo
  write mid-draw resets the engine's charge**, chopping long holds back to level 1–2 (short holds sneak
  between writes = the observed occasional `..2`). Fix: the watcher **never clamps while
  `AttackButtonPressed()`** — deferred until the trigger is free. (Same ammo-write/fire-state interplay
  family as the Havoc charge-gate lessons.)

### Fixed - Fire Bow charge move dead after first bleed-out (user, 2026-07-08)

- **"The firebow charge move doesn't work"** — root cause: the HB21 pack threads its per-player bow
  watchers ONCE at connect, and `bow_base_impact_watcher` / `bow_base_wield_watcher` both
  `endon("death")` — so the player's **first real bleed-out killed them permanently**. A full-charge
  shot still fired the `elemental_bow_demongate4` projectile, but the impact handler that opens the
  PORTAL no longer existed → "charge does nothing" (tap-shot chompers died with it; a revived down was
  fine — only real death notifies `"death"`). Fix: `bow_demongate_watchers_respawn_loop` in
  `_zm_weap_elemental_bow_demongate.gsc` re-threads the three watchers after every death → respawn
  (no duplicate-thread risk: the loop re-arms only after the old set provably died). The 2026-07-07
  charge-cost dvar revert (`bg_zm_dlc1_chargeShotMultipleBulletsForFullCharge` = 2) was verified still
  correct — this was a different bug with the same symptom.

  must carry its own demigod clamp. First such case fixed same-commit: the Panzer melee override

    grab is inescapable), armor is solid (destructible visuals are DLC1-gated), exactly ONE panzer GDT.

### Fixed - Four gameplay bugs: Mule Kick swap stability / implanted-dup grab / Havoc+Turbo sprint delay / airborne drops (user, 2026-07-08)

- **Mule Kick gun no longer changes on twin/PaP swaps** (user: "the mulekick gun shouldn't change when
  weapons are removed and given back on a twin switch"). Root cause: stock `take_additionalprimaryweapon`
  removes the LAST qualifying primary in `GetWeaponsListPrimaries()` — an engine list ordered by
  `GiveWeapon` — and every twin/PaP swap (`_acc_weapon_variants::swap_weapon`, `_acc_pap_levels`
  `acc_do_transform`/`replay_pack_draw`) re-appends the swapped gun to the tail, silently making it the
  at-risk gun (PaP your 1st gun → it becomes the one you lose). Fix in `_acc_gun_badges.gsc`: a per-player
  **stable acquisition-ordered list of LOGICAL guns** (`self.acc_mule_order`, identities =
  `acc_weapon_variants::true_base` so twins/_up forms keep the same identity and our swaps can't move
  them). `init()` **unregisters stock's `on_laststand`** (`callback::remove_callback`, guarded) and installs
  `acc_mule_on_laststand`, which mirrors stock's guards + revive bookkeeping (plural weapondata map +
  singular field for `level.return_additionalprimaryweapon`) but takes the stable-order tail. `pred_mule`
  (MULE badge) now reads the SAME order (`mule_desired_at_risk_base`), so badge == real removal, always.
  Degrades safely: if the unregister ever no-ops, stock takes first and our count-gated handler no-ops.
- **Implanted items can no longer be grabbed** (user: "player shouldn't be able to grab an item they
  already have implanted"). `_acc_boss_items::watch_pickup`: an already-IMPLANTED duplicate now REFUSES the
  grab ("Already implanted" print) and **leaves the pickup on the ground** (glow + 60s lifetime intact) for
  teammates — per-grabber, so a teammate who lacks it grabs normally. Was: implanted-or-carried dup →
  +3 shards and the drop despawned (consumed a teammate's item). A duplicate of a loose CARRY (transient,
  per-player) still converts to 3 shards. docs/12 updated.
- **Havoc + Turbocharger "delay after running" killed — the TURBO TWIN AXIS** (user: long first-shot
  delay after sprint / first hip-fire; then "keep 0.98 WITHOUT turbocharger, faster WITH it"). Root cause
  was GDT-side, not the charge script: the Havoc ships **`sprintOutTime 0.98`** (every other Apex gun:
  0.3), and the engine blocks firing until sprint-out completes. Non-turbo holders never felt it (the
  1.25s script charge masks it); a TURBO holder eats it raw — and ZM auto-sprint makes most first shots
  sprint-out shots. A GDT field is baked per def (no per-player setter), so the per-player ask is a twin
  swap: **8 hand-cloned `apex_beam_rifle[_up]_acc_[recoil50_][fastreload_]turbo` forms with
  `sprintOutTime 0.2`** (blocks in `acc_weapon_variants.gdt`, generated by scratchpad
  `gen_havoc_turbo_twins.js`; zone `weaponfull` lines added; the 8 normal forms keep 0.98 untouched,
  backups `*.acc-havoc-sprintout-orig`). New **`turbo` variant axis** in `_acc_weapon_variants.gsc`
  (`axis_turbo` off `self.acc_item_turbocharger`; token deliberately LAST in canonical order so non-Havoc
  guns degrade to their other twins; allow-list bakes turbo combos for the Havoc ONLY — GetWeapon on an
  unbaked name is a runtime error). `apply/remove_turbocharger` poke `request_reconcile` for an instant
  bench swap. **Race guard**: `reconcile` defers while `self.acc_havoc_gated` (set at charge-gate engage,
  cleared in `restore_gate`) — a swap during the 0/0 ammo blank would destroy the gated ammo. Twin count
  132 → 140 (cap ~230). Turbo twins keep `fireDelay 0.1` (the charge press-guard stays on every form).
- **Floating drops ROOT CAUSE found + fixed: the floor-snap trace hit the dying boss's own body** (user:
  "items still floating — the GLOW is airborne too", i.e. the ORIGIN never snapped; freshest repro a
  Rogue Protector drop). The snap's `BulletTrace` starts 60u above the death origin — INSIDE the hovering
  boss's corpse — and a solid AI hit returns `position` ≈ the airborne origin, so the "snap" pinned the
  pickup mid-air (ground zombies never showed it: their corpse already sits on the floor). New shared
  **`acc_utility::drop_floor_origin`**: steps 4u below any ACTOR/PLAYER hit and re-traces (≤8 steps) until
  it reaches **world geometry** (`fraction < 1 && !isdefined(tr["entity"])` — the stock world-hit idiom,
  `vehicle_shared.gsc:2772`) or a solid non-AI entity (a brushmodel bridge/platform is a floor); a true
  miss keeps the origin (never buries, fixing the latent miss-snapped-to-ray-end bug too). Both drop
  paths (`_acc_boss_items::spawn_pickup`, `_acc_data_shards::spawn_pickup_at`) route through it;
  step/miss diagnostics on the dev-visible `drops_debug` channel. Also measured the real mesh bounds of
  the carve props from their `.xmodel_bin` vertex data (LZ4-decoded) — all three 4×-scaled props are
  base-pivot (worst seat error ~2u), confirming the model seat was never the floating cause (the
  `acc_drop_scale_lift_add` seat dvar stays as a fine-tune knob only).

### Changed - Gun badge system: dedicated module + predicate registry + robustness (user, 2026-07-08)

The flag-badge logic became its own module so the system is provably correct per-badge and trivial to
extend (user: "works flawlessly and easy to add new badges for different scenarios").

- **New module `_acc_gun_badges.gsc`** replaces the inline mask in `_zm_aetherium_hud::player_gun_badge_watch`
  (removed; the `#using _zm_weapons` it needed went with it). A **predicate registry**: `init()` calls
  `register_badge(bit, &pred_fn)` once per badge; the per-player `badge_watch` (0.25s change-guarded poll,
  threaded from `_acc_main::on_player_connect`) recomputes the whole `acc_badges` mask each tick from every
  predicate and pushes on change. Each predicate is `self=player, cur=held → bool`, self-contained and
  independently correct — one badge can't break another, and every order of operations converges within a
  tick. **Adding a badge = write `pred_x`, `register_badge(bit, &pred_x)`, one `ACC_GUN_BADGES` entry.** The
  `acc_badges` clientfield stays *registered* in `_zm_aetherium_hud.gsc/.csc` (toplayer bit-layout lockstep).
- **Mule robustness (user: "should always be attached to their 3rd gun; edge cases when players go down"):**
  `pred_mule` now resolves every primary to `true_base` before the `is_weapon_included/upgraded` filter and
  for the held-gun match. Fixes the latent case where `reconcile` twins ALL primaries under a Mega axis
  (Speed Cola / Deadshot) — a raw twin fails the stock filter, which would drop the count below 3 and blink
  the badge off mid-game; and holding a twin OF the 3rd gun now still lights it. Stock-accurate when no twin
  is active. Naturally hides while downed / on Mule loss / `_retain_perks`.
- **Turbo:** order-independent by construction (pure poll) — implant-then-draw and draw-then-implant both
  light within a tick. Unchanged logic, moved to `pred_turbo`.
- **Nuclear Energy badge (bit 2) LIVE:** `pred_nuclear` reuses `acc_damage::is_energy_weapon` (the buff's
  single source of truth) + the Mahem launcher, so the badge and the +15% damage buff can never disagree.
  Shows while the item is implanted AND the held gun is one Nuclear buffs (same "must be implanted +
  per-held-gun" rule as Turbo). Art landed 2026-07-08 (`i_acc_badge_nuclear`, gold "Damage+" atom pennant),
  chip enabled in `ACC_GUN_BADGES` (bit 2).
- **Wiring:** `_acc_main` (#using + `init()` after pap_levels + `on_player_connect`), zone scriptparsetree
  line, dev-probe comment updated (bit 2 NUKE). **Docs**: docs/28 (registry recipe + robustness notes).

  stays y 644) so the approved distance to the ammo readout is identical.

  Turbocharger). Root cause: the badge row subscribed to the `acc_badges` model with
  `Engine.GetModel`, but that field is **toplayer-scoped** — its UI-model node doesn't exist until the
  server bridge's `createuimodel` fires on the first change, so `GetModel` attached the listener to a

  **`Engine.CreateModel`** (the exact pattern the working currency chips use for the same bridge —
  AetheriumPlayerInfo.lua acc_shards/acc_mb/acc_exo/acc_maxhp). Tier lanes (accPapTier/accOcTier) were
  unaffected — clientuimodel-scope auto-creates the node — but CreateModel is idempotent so both lanes
  now share one path. TURBO shows while a Turbocharger is implanted AND the Havoc is the held weapon.

### Changed - Havoc press-guard fireDelay 0.15 → 0.1 (user, 2026-07-08)

- User (turbo'd Havoc): "I feel a tiny delay even with turbocharger" — the felt delay is the GDT
  `fireDelay` press-guard, shared by every holder (no per-player engine knob). Cut **0.15 → 0.1** on
  all 8 defs (base `apex_beam_rifle_zm` in zeroy/APEX_BO3.gdt, `_up` in acc_apex_up.gdt, 6 twins in
  acc_weapon_variants.gdt — install-side, backups `*.acc-havoc-firedelay01-orig`; `gdtdb /update` run).
- 0.1 = 2 server frames = the **minimum safe** value: the 50ms charge-gate poll blanks ammo on frame 1,
  the engine latch fires on frame 2 → one-frame margin (0.05 would tie the same frame and leak
  full-damage uncharged shots on tap, gutting the charge mechanic). Turbo holders now feel ~100 ms;
  non-turbo charge behavior unchanged. True-zero for turbo (fireDelay-0 def swap via the variants
  pipeline) deliberately NOT taken — deferred unless 100 ms still reads as lag in play.

### Added - Turbocharger charge-skip diagnostic prints (dev-only) (user, 2026-07-08)

- User report: "Havoc charge-up with Turbocharger is broken." Full-chain audit found **no static defect**:
  `apply_turbocharger` (bench implant) correctly sets `self.acc_item_turbocharger`, `_acc_havoc_charge`'s
  loop provably never engages the gate while that flag is true, the install GDTs carry no engine wind-up
  (`fireDelay 0.15` on base/`_up`/twins; `spinUpTime 1` is ignored — the Alternator/Prowler carry the same
  fields and fire instantly; the `acc_havoc_chg.gdt` chg1-4 staged defs are orphaned v1/v2-era leftovers
  referenced by nothing), and the deployed scripts hash-match the repo in the current `.ff`.
- Since the logfile writes nothing on this box, added **3 dev-gated `IPrintLnBold` probes** so one run
  localizes the failure: `[TURBO] flag ON/OFF` in `apply/remove_turbocharger`, `[HAVOC] charge gate
  ENGAGED (turbo=0)` on gate engage, `[HAVOC] turbo: charge skipped (firing live)` on the turbo press
  edge. Read: no `[TURBO] ON` on implant = equip path broke; `ENGAGED` after implant = flag cleared in
  between; `skipped` but still winds up = engine/GDT side. Pairs with the `[BADGE]` probe's live `turbo=`.

### Fixed - Code-review sweep: 3 match-ending crash paths + 2 dead features + hardening (review, 2026-07-08)

Adversarial review of the branch diff (8 finder angles, every finding independently verified against the
code before fixing). All fixes GSC/CSC/tools-only — no geometry, `-GscOnly` build.

- **Boss-drop crash (pool exhaustion)**: `_acc_boss_items::spawn_pickup` called `setmodel` on the raw
  `spawn()` returns for the pickup **and** the new loot-glow host with no `isdefined` guard — at 4p
  entity-pool pressure a boss kill crashed the whole match. Both spawns now guarded (glowless/lost drop
  beats a dead match), matching the abyss-beacon/glitch-altar guards from the same sweep.
- **Two corpse-reap races after `waittill("death")`**: `_acc_civil_protector::death_watch` (StopLoopSound +
  `self.origin`) and `_acc_boss::watch_mini_boss_death` (`self.origin`/`.acc_bottle_drop`) deref'd a possibly
  already-reaped corpse — the exact race `phantom_death_watch` was guarded against. Both now capture fields
  behind one `isdefined(self)` (killer-origin fallback for the drop), and the Brutus respawn bookkeeping
  runs even when the corpse is gone (previously a throw ALSO jammed `acc_brutus_active` forever).
- **Leviathan Axe rewrote grenade damage**: the held-weapon fallback in `_acc_damage::on_ai_damage` had no
  meansofdeath check, so a frag/Widow's Wine thrown while holding the axe became fractional axe damage
  (one-shot every zombie in the blast; ~5%/frag on bosses, bypassing the multiplier chain + boss per-hit
  cap). Fallback now gated on `is_melee_mod(meansofdeath)`.
- **Fire Bow + Leviathan Axe were UNOBTAINABLE**: both were fully wired (0.41% box weight, claim caps,
  WONDER PaP tier, CSV `in_box=TRUE`) but missing from `_acc_map_randomizer`'s `box_weapons` array — and
  step 1 of the pool registration wipes the CSV flags, making that array the sole authority. The axe could
  not be obtained in ANY mode. Both added to the array.
- **Paradise finale lost the Rogue Protector**: the boss wave relied on `spawn_boss()`'s deleted
  "in front of a player" entrance — the same-branch Plaza-anchor rework stranded him at z=14, unreachable
  from the z=-1200 arena, jamming the cap-1 count so no RP ever appeared in the finale. `spawn_boss()` now
  has a paradise branch spawning ON a living player (mirrors the Avogadro's).
- **Avogadro sealed-Lab stranding**: the roster spawn used the Lab struct unconditionally; from round 9 the
  Lab can still be sealed (both `enter_lab_*` doors unbought = path-disconnected) → invisible unkillable
  boss + perpetual machine hacks. Lab spawn kept (user ask) when the Lab is OPEN; if both doors are closed
  he spawns on a living player instead.
- **Trench Warden silently forfeited on pool-full first spawn**: the `nsz_brutus` pool-full bail's "director
  re-owes him" comment was false — no Brutus debt director exists, `brutus_power_watch` is one-shot, and the
  respawn loop needs a kill round only a kill sets. `run_mini_boss` now backdates a synthetic kill round on
  spawn failure so `round_hook_loop` retries next round.
- **Aetherium HUD dropped first-snapshot values**: `_zm_aetherium_hud.csc::set_ui_model_value` silently
  discarded clientfield updates when the client's UI-model root wasn't ready, and every GSC feeder is
  change-guarded (never re-sends) → teammate MB/Exo/maxHP could stay 0/stale all match. Now deferred
  latest-wins per (client, field) with a bounded retry instead of dropped.
- **prep_release now FAILS on the dev/god hardcode**: new "ship-safe flags" gate (Track A) greps the entry
  script for active `level.acc_dev/acc_god = true` hardcodes — the in-code comments previously (correctly)
  warned prep_release could not catch this. The hardcodes themselves are left ON (deliberate test state,
  user 2026-07-07); stale in-code comments updated, duplicate commented god-line removed.
- **Cleanup (verified safe)**: dead `nearest_valid_player()` removed from `_acc_boss_avogadro` (never
  called); its `grant_drops` duplicate floor-snap pre-clamp removed (spawn_pickup's universal dvar-gated
  snap covers every drop).
- **Docs**: docs/55 (new prep_release gate). Review also surfaced non-blocking cleanups deferred for a
  later pass: shared guarded hudelem builder (~15 pasted pool-full guards), `IS_TRUE` vs hand-expanded dev
  gates (~15 sites), stale "round*300 pts" comments (actual default 180), per-module wonder/hackable-machine
  identity lists that must be hand-synced, 4Hz visibility/inventory poll loops.

### Changed - Fire Bow demon-gate NERFED + PaP-scaled (user, 2026-07-07)

- **The Fire Bow's charged demon-gate now scales with PaP instead of being full-power at base**
  (`_zm_weap_elemental_bow_demongate.gsc`). The demon-gate is what made the bow OP: an instant AoE one-shot in a
  **96u** radius **plus** 4-6 auto-hunting "chompers" (`c_zom_chomper`) that eat the surrounding horde for ~8s -
  effectively a room-clear per charged shot, ~75 shots per clip. Now the un-upgraded bow is deliberately weak and
  each PaP tier restores + improves it (all live dvars; the pack now `#using`s our tier module and reads the
  shooter's held-bow tier via `acc_pap_levels::get_tier`):
  - **Blast radius**: 50 / 65 / 80 / 95 by tier (+15/tier, t0/T1/T2/T3) — was a flat 96. `acc_firebow_aoe_radius_t0..3`.
  - **Chomper count**: 1 / 1 / 2 / 3 by tier — was a flat 4-6. Base + 1st PaP field a single chomper. `acc_firebow_chompers_t0..3`.
  - **Clip size**: 30 arrows base + 1st PaP -> 50 at 2nd PaP and beyond (`acc_firebow_clip_t0..3` = 30/30/50/50),
    clamped at runtime by a per-holder watcher (PaP is in-place, so no per-variant GDT clip; GDT clipSize 75 is
    just the ceiling).
  - **Charged-shot cost**: REVERTED to the pack-stock **2 arrows/full-charge**. Overriding the global
    `bg_zm_dlc1_chargeShotMultipleBulletsForFullCharge` 2 -> 4 BROKE the full charge ("charge move does nothing"):
    the demon-gate weapon's charge is designed around 2, so 4 made FULL charge unreachable and the shot stayed
    partial (`elemental_bow_demongate`, a single chomper) instead of firing `elemental_bow_demongate4` (the portal).
    A higher cost, if wanted, must be a post-portal ammo deduction in `bow_demongate_open_portal`, not this dvar.
  - **Targeting split** (user 2026-07-07): the **charged AoE hits specials/elites/bosses** - glitch, Apothicon
    Fury (guaranteed one-hit, below), shielded, and bosses - but the **chompers ignore all of them and eat NORMAL
    zombies only** (`bow_demongate_chomper_validate_target` excludes glitch/shielded/fury/boss/mini-boss).
  - **PaP TIER DETECTION FIX** (`_acc_pap_levels.gsc`): the demon-gate form is STATICALLY `is_weapon_upgraded`
    (it's an upgraded bow variant), so `get_tier` misread the base bow as tier 2 (clip stuck at 50, radius/chompers
    at tier-2 values) and the in-place PaP (CSV upgrade=self) couldn't advance cleanly. The Fire Bow now has a
    dedicated in-place PaP handler + tier counter (`acc_pap_firebow` / `player.acc_firebow_tier` / `firebow_tier`),
    exactly like the Action Figure - a clean 0/1/2/3 ramp charged at the WONDER price tier (10k/15k/20k), routed
    from both the surface and Paradise PaP machines. `get_tier` special-cases the bow so the HUD + scaling read it.
  - **"Can't PaP the bow" FIXED** (`make_firebow_packable`): same root cause as the Action Figure - no `_up`
    asset means stock's `can_upgrade_weapon()` is false and `player_use_can_pack_now()` HID the PaP machine
    while the bow was held (and the demon-gate form may be AAT-exempt, so the AAT fallback couldn't save it).
    Fix points the bow's `.upgrade` at itself + un-exempts it from AAT so the machine shows; `acc_pap_validate`
    still intercepts it (returns false before any stock swap) and runs the in-place `acc_pap_firebow`.
  - **PaP cost-display bug FIXED (also fixes the Action Figure)** (`pap_cost_display_keeper` /
    `set_inplace_pap_cost`): an `is_weapon_upgraded` weapon's machine prompt reads `self.aat_cost`, but the old
    in-place branch always wrote `self.cost` - so a PaP'd **Action Figure** (its speed twins are is_weapon_upgraded)
    showed a **stale/wrong price**, and the Fire Bow (is_weapon_upgraded at every tier) would too. The shared
    `set_inplace_pap_cost` now writes whichever field the prompt actually reads (aat_cost vs cost), per held form.
  - **Apothicon Fury = GUARANTEED one-hit** (user 2026-07-07: "just a one hit", `_acc_damage.gsc`): replaced the
    old x8 multiplier (`acc_firebow_fury_mult`) - ANY Fire Bow hit (the direct arrow OR the charged demon-gate
    AoE) now deals the Fury's **full max health**, so a single hit always kills it regardless of the round's HP.
    Furies are trench elites (not `acc_is_boss`), so the boss per-hit cap never clamps it. Dvar
    `acc_firebow_fury_onehit` (default 1; 0 = off -> raw demon-gate damage).
  - Unchanged: the instant one-shot lethality *within* the (smaller) blast and the chomper HP budget.

### Fixed - Leviathan boss scaling (~150 hits -> 20) + loot glow sits at ground level (user, 2026-07-07)

- **Leviathan Axe boss hits FIXED** (`_acc_damage.gsc::on_ai_damage`): the per-enemy fractional block gated on
  `weapon.name` containing "leviathan", but a fireType-Melee weapon's SWING does NOT reliably report itself as
  the damage-event `weapon` (same reason the Action Figure needs two names, and the Thundergun reads
  `GetCurrentWeapon` for its tier). So the block never fired on any swing and bosses fell through to the normal
  scaled path — ~130-150 hits to kill Avogadro (150 GDT dmg x 1.0 bal x 3.25 global ≈ 487/hit vs ~65k HP)
  instead of the intended 20. Now the axe is resolved from the damage weapon **OR** the attacker's HELD weapon
  (`attacker GetCurrentWeapon()`) — melee-only, so any player-attributed AI hit while it's in hand is a swing —
  and the tier lookup uses the resolved weapon. Restores the per-enemy hits-to-kill (zombie 1 / glitch 1 /
  shielded 5→2 / Fury 2→1 / boss 20/17/14/10) on actual swings, not just in theory.
- **Dropped-item loot glow now sits at GROUND level** (`_acc_boss_items.gsc::spawn_pickup`): the pickup model is
  lifted `z_lift` units so its high-pivot mesh doesn't sink, and the glow rode up with it — floating above the
  floor. The aura now anchors to a SEPARATE invisible `tag_origin` host at the drop origin (a few units under,
  live dvar `acc_item_glow_z`, default -4), same trick the PaP glow uses to drop its aura down the cabinet. The
  host is stored on the pickup and deleted in lockstep by `cleanup_pickup()` (no leak).

### Added - Buy a perk door PERMANENTLY open for 2 Mega Bottles (user, 2026-07-07)

- **New buy in `_acc_perk_doors.gsc`**: a per-alcove `trigger_radius_use` lets a player spend
  **2 Empty Mega Bottles** (`ACC_PERK_DOOR_UNLOCK_COST`, via `acc_mega_bottles::try_consume_bottle`) to
  **open one CLOSED Lab perk door for the rest of the game**. The unlocked door then **drops out of the
  per-round roll** (`candidates_excluding_last` skips permanents) and is **force-open on every reconcile**
  (`is_permanent()` added to `reconcile_doors`' `want_open`), so it becomes a **BONUS always-open alcove ON
  TOP of the 4 rotating ones** — not one of the 4. Persists as `level.acc_perk_doors_permanent[spec]` (level
  state, never reset).

  door face (x = alcove centre from `alcove_x_span`, y = the south face `ACC_ALCOVE_Y_SOUTH`, z = chest
  height), shown/usable **only while that door is closed and not-yet-permanent** — same per-player
  `SetInvisibleToPlayer` visibility idiom as the mega machines; hidden when the door is open via rotation or
  once bought. `UseTriggerRequireLookAt` so a run-by past the 10-door row doesn't mass-prompt.

  on an under-funded use. xref lint green.

### Added - "The Armory" upper room: team weapon rack + mega-bottle exchange (user, 2026-07-07)

- **New module `_acc_armory.gsc`** (`acc_armory::init()` wired in `_acc_main` after `acc_transfer`, `.zone`
  line added) — houses two team-support stations for a planned upper room reached by staircases up from the
  Plaza. **Pure GSC** (script-spawned `trigger_radius_use` pads, the `_acc_transfer`/`_acc_glitch_altar`
  recipe): **zero LED-bake risk**, ships `-GscOnly`. Built + linked clean (fresh `.ff`, xref lint green).

  Exchange choice, not a directed give — sidesteps the co-op `closest_player_override`/snapshot hazards).
  A player **DEPOSITS** their held primary into `level.acc_armory_rack` (FIFO of weapon objects); any teammate
  **WITHDRAWS** it. Guards: `is_player_valid` both ends; deposit rejects non-primary/melee/mine + **capped
  wonder weapons** (`wonder_cap_key` — a racked wonder could bypass the per-match claim cap); withdraw has a
  **mandatory free-slot gate** (`weapon_give` at the limit silently destroys the held gun) + `b_switch=false`
  (no view-yank) + "already own it" guard. Damage auto-tunes (name-keyed `acc_weapon_balance_mult`).

  spend **1 Empty Mega Bottle** (`try_consume_bottle`) for a **weighted random reward "item"** — all-positive
  (Max Ammo / Insta-Kill / Double Points / Carpenter / Fire Sale / Nuke / Data Shards / free perk). Reward
  powerups are exactly the set this map already wires HUD icons for, so every drop is confirmed valid.
- **Upper-room geometry BUILT** (`tools/gen_upper_room.js` — a bake-safe vertical generator cloned from
  `gen_abyss_layer.js`, idempotent + `--revert`-able): an enclosed **mezzanine loft** (floor z=288, room to
  z=560, footprint x[300,900] y[-230,370]) over the CLEAR east wing of the Plaza, reached by an **18-tread
  16-rise/16-run staircase** (x[520,700], climbs z=0→288 into a south-wall doorway; navmesh links so zombies
  path up) + 4 always-on interior lights. Stations now sit in the loft (z=288). **No zone edit** — the
  `start_zone` player_volume is z[-166,1041], so the loft is already in-zone (no OOB; zombies climb from Plaza
  spawns). Placement collision-checked vs the live `.map`. **LED bake: BAKED** (59.6 s, no `brush.cpp:1860`).
- **Dvars**: `acc_armory_rack_max` (8), `acc_armory_bottle_cost` (1), `acc_armory_bottle_shards` (5).
- **Docs**: new docs/60_armory.md (full design + built geometry); docs/03 (layout); docs/34 (dvars).

### Changed - Wonder PaP tier + Leviathan per-enemy hits-to-kill + weapon-table overhaul (user, 2026-07-07)

- **New WONDER PaP price tier** (`_acc_pap_levels.gsc::tier_cost`): **10000 / 15000 / 20000** for the 4
  wonder weapons (Thundergun / Fire Bow / Leviathan Axe / Blast-O-Matic), flipped from TOP in
  `pap_price_bucket` ([acc] manual overrides in the generated block). Action Figure stays TOP.

  Prowler MID->BOT, Grav MID->BOT.
- **Leviathan Axe = per-enemy hits-to-kill melee** (`_acc_damage.gsc`): the GoW axe has **NO fixed damage
  number** - each hit deals a FRACTION of the target's max HP (`lev_dmg = int(maxHP / hits) + 1`), so it kills
  in a hit count **configured per enemy type**, HP-independent: normal zombie **1** (a one-hit knife) · glitch
  zombie **1** · shielded zombie **5** · Apothicon Fury **2** · heavyweight boss **20 / 17 / 14 / 10** by PaP
  tier (t0/T1/T2/T3, `ACC_LEVIATHAN_HITS_T0..T3`). **At 2nd PaP and beyond (tier >= 2) the anti-elite counts
  sharpen: shielded 5 -> 2 and Apothicon Fury 2 -> 1 (one-shot)** (dvars `acc_leviathan_hits_shield_pap2` /
  `..._fury_pap2`). Live dvars `acc_leviathan_hits_{zombie,glitch,shield,shield_pap2,fury,fury_pap2,t0..t3}`.
  This dedicated block runs before the normal damage formula + boss per-hit cap and returns the exact fraction,
  so those never apply to the axe. (Replaces the earlier fixed-cap-only boss implementation.)
- **Fire Bow hard-counters the trench Apothicon Furies** (`_acc_damage.gsc`): the Fire Bow's demon-gate
  radiusDamage (only 1x zombie HP = 10% of a Fury's 10x-HP) now gets x8 (dvar acc_firebow_fury_mult) vs any
  `b_is_apothicon_fury` target -> ~one-shots the fiery "lava" trench elites. Applied before the boss cap
  (Furies aren't bosses, so no clamp).
- **Apothicon Fury alive-cap = player count** (`_acc_fury.gsc::effective_cap`): was deep-players x 2 (up to
  8); now the live lobby size (solo 1 / duo 2 / trio 3 / quad 4), with the actor-budget ceiling (8) still a
  hard safety backstop.
- **docs/41 weapon table overhaul**: `tools/gen_weapon_stats.js` now parses EVERYTHING from code (added
  box % from `acc_box_weight` + tactical pre-roll, per-gun PaP cost from `pap_price_bucket`, wonder claim
  caps from `wonder_cap_limit`, and full GDT stats for the 5 specials via a recursive source_data/_custom
  GDT scan). New columns: **Box %**, **PaP cost T1/T2/T3**; the specials table gains **Raw dmg / bal /
  Eff-per-hit / Clip-Reserve / fireTime / vs-Boss**. ASM1 removed. Self-check aborts on any roster/code
  price drift (caught + fixed 3 stale tiers: AK-74u, CEL-3, MK14).

### Added - Turbocharger implant: 0-charge Havoc (user, 2026-07-07)

New boss/zombie-drop **implant item #8, the Turbocharger** — a deliberately hyper-niche mod for the
Apex **Havoc** (`apex_beam_rifle`). While implanted, the carrier's Havoc fires with **0 charge-up
time**: `_acc_havoc_charge::havoc_charge_loop` reads `self.acc_item_turbocharger` and, while set,
**never engages its script wind-up gate**, so the beam rifle keeps its base GDT `fireDelay 0.15`
press-guard and simply fires when held (no 1.25 s spool). Inert on every other weapon — pointless
without a Havoc (equip it without one and it's a wasted slot).
- **Item plumbing** (`_acc_boss_items.gsc`): item #8 `turbocharger` added to `build_item_pool` (pool
  7→8), reusing the now-freed Li'l Arnie pickup prop `p7_fxanim_zm_zod_octobomb_mod` (already
  zone-packed + precached — **zero new assets**, distinct silhouette). `apply_turbocharger` /
  `remove_turbocharger` set/clear the flag, mirroring the `payroll_ledger` / `lucky_clover`
  cross-module-flag pattern. Drops, carry, Plaza-bench implant, duplicate→Shards, and die-out loss all
  ride the existing item pipeline unchanged.
- **Gate skip** (`_acc_havoc_charge.gsc`): a `!turbo` guard on the charge press-edge, plus an instant
  gate-drop (`StopLocalSound` + restore ammo) if the flag reads true mid-charge / on Havoc re-select,
  so equip and weapon-swap edges never strand a blanked 0/0 gun. Clearing the flag (bench swap or dying
  out) restores the normal 1.25 s script charge on the next trigger pull. No new `#using` — it's a plain
  player field read.
- **Docs**: docs/12_boss_items.md — item table row 8, an honest-framing caveat (it's a cross-module
  flag, not a runtime GDT edit; "0 charge" = the gate being absent), and the at-a-glance count 6→8.
