### Fixed - Second 4-player coop sweep: 18 fixes across 11 files (pre-publish audit #2, 2026-07-06)

Four parallel reviews over the surface audit #1 didn't sweep (cross-cutting disconnect races,
array/size math, boss-subsystem concurrency, client/LUI pressure); every finding re-verified
against source before fixing. A throw in server GSC ends the match for the whole lobby, so each
guard below is crash-severity unless marked otherwise.

Fire-without-disconnect (worst class):
- **`nsz_brutus.gsc::spawn_brutus`**: `zombie_utility::spawn_zombie()` returns UNDEFINED when the
  actor pool is at cap (4p horde steals the freed slot same-frame); the immediate `.is_boss` write
  threw every time this fired on a boss round. Guarded + gives the boss debt back.
- **`_acc_bus_trench.gsc::trench_warning_on`**: `ensure_trench_warning` legitimately bails with both
  hudelems undefined on pool exhaustion, but the caller ran `fadeovertime` on them anyway.
- **`_acc_lockdown_challenge.gsc::create_challenge_hud`**: 3 bare `hud::create*` (the audit-#1 crash
  class) at purge commit - exactly when the pool is most saturated (3 elems x 4 sealed players).

Disconnect / reap races:
- **`_acc_boss_brutus.gsc`**: trench-warden drop-in retry loop got the `isalive` condition hoist its
  paradise twin already had (condition derefs `self.origin` after the wait); BOTH variants' post-loop
  logs deref'd `self` again after a reap - guarded.
- **`_acc_lockdown_challenge.gsc::is_in_party`**: raw `party[i] == player` on a snapshot held for the
  whole challenge; a disconnected member's entry is undefined and `entity == undefined` THROWS
  (polled 1/s per zombie). The one unguarded compare among the party consumers.
- **`_acc_boss_phantom.gsc::players_not_yet_hit`**: chain-special `hit[]` compare on a player who
  disconnected between hops (found independently by two reviews). Also `phantom_death_watch` deref'd
  `self.origin` outside its own isdefined guard - now bails before the reward block.
- **`nsz_brutus.gsc::note_tracker`**: `self.brutus_enemy == player` swing compare - the warden think
  tick clears `brutus_enemy` mid-swing-anim (also found by two reviews).
- **`zm_zod_robot.gsc`**: Civil Protector purchaser deref after `wait 1.5` (unitrigger thread only
  endons kill_trigger); plus the `foreach(e_player...)` loops SHADOWED the purchaser param (renamed;
  latent, not yet a crash). **`archetype_zod_companion.gsc`**: robot revive wrote
  `player.reviveTrigger.beingRevived` after `waittill("goal")` with no re-check - a teammate winning
  the revive race undefines the trigger; bails + cleans up (cleanup's raw `== 1` compare also guarded).
- **`_zm_ai_avogadro.gsc::choose_a_spawn` / `nsz_brutus.gsc::choose_a_spawn`**: unguarded
  `players[0].origin` on possibly-empty GetPlayers() (mass-quit tick). **`_zm_ai_avogadro.csc`**:
  StopFX on an undefined FX handle on join-in-progress initial snapshot (client error).

Malfunctions / correctness (not crashes):
- **`_acc_damage.gsc::thundergun_boss_blast`**: the 500ms debounce was keyed per BOSS, so two players
  co-firing Thunderguns at one boss silently swallowed the second blast (GDT damage is 0 - the gate
  WAS the damage). Now keyed per (boss, attacker entity number).
- **`_acc_boss_brutus.gsc`**: NEW shared `level.acc_brutus_spawn_lock` serializes `spawn_one` /
  `spawn_one_paradise` - the pack handoff (shared spawn points + one level-wide notify) let a trench
  respawn in flight at paradise-onslaught start wake BOTH waiters off one actor (one double-promoted
  warden + one unpromoted pack-HP rogue). Added the missing `#insert shared.gsh` (lint caught it).
- **`zm_zod_robot.gsc::zod_robot_do_landing_damage`**: friendly Civil Protector landing splash
  insta-killed (health+10000) any BOSS within 350u - free boss kill exploit. Same all-boss exclusion
  as `_acc_civil_protector::landing_kill_splash` (the 2026-07-03 multi-boss fix).
- **`_acc_health_bars.gsc::make_boss_bar_set`**: pool-full guards on the dormant 2D boss bar
  (dvar-gated off in publish; guarded for any future re-enable; downstream already tolerates).

Verified clean / no change needed: the 3 LUI state-pool items audit #1 deferred are NOT leaks
(kill-feed re-register = single-slot replace semantics, bounded; plus-points popups = dead code on

### Fixed - Shotgun `damageRange2` inversion aborted the linker (launch build, 2026-07-06)

The shotgun range `-45%` pass (`shotgun_range_45_pk_best.js`) scaled `maxDamageRange` + `minDamageRange`
x0.55 but LEFT `damageRange2` untouched. On the Skye shotguns `damageRange2` originally equalled
`minDamageRange`, so cutting min below it made the falloff breakpoints non-monotonic -> the linker aborted
`UNRECOVERABLE ERROR: Damage range distances went backwards for weapon t9_streetsweeper` (it stops at the
first; Tac-19, Olympia, CEL-3 were equally broken - 8 defs across 4 install-side Skye GDTs). This is what
failed the Launcher build (and, downstream, the Workshop publish). Fix: clamped each def's `damageRange2`
down to its own `minDamageRange` (== scaling it by the same x0.55), restoring monotonicity
(`maxDamageRange` < `damageRange2` == `minDamageRange`). Peacekeeper is unaffected (`damageRange2` = 0 =
unused single-tier falloff). Refreshed `gdt.db` (`gdtdb /update`), then a full cod2map64 + LED + linker build
verified clean (no error, fresh `.ff`, lightmaps fresh). Install-side GDT edit (not in repo). Memory:
`shotgun-damagerange2-linker-backwards`.

### Fixed - Coop (4-player) crash + thread-safety hardening (crash audit, 2026-07-06)

Multi-agent crash audit focused on 4-player edge cases (disconnects, pool exhaustion, boss
spawn races). Applied the confirmed fixes; each is a guard/removal with no behavior change in
normal 1-2p play. Remaining audit coverage gaps (LUI/Lua state-pool, cross-cutting sweeps) are
NOT yet done.

- **HUD toast pool-exhaustion crash** (`_acc_utility.gsc::hud_msg_slot`): when the shared hudelem
  pool fills (a demonstrated 4-player condition, memory `server-hudelem-pool-exhaustion-coop`),
  `he_check` returns undefined and the array store removes the slot key, so the following
  `setPoint`/`SetText` ran on undefined and ended the game. Added an `isdefined` bail. `hud_msg` is
  called from 14+ modules, so this fired constantly at 4p - likely a primary cause of the coop crashes.
- **Card HUD same class** (`_acc_ui.gsc::card_ensure`): `createIcon` return now guarded before the
  field writes.
- **Brutus reaped mid-spawn** (`nsz_brutus.gsc::spawn_brutus`): a 4p team burning Brutus down during
  his spawn-rise anim could null `brutus` before the anim wait returned; `brutus thread
  custom_find_flesh()` then threw "not an entity". Added `isdefined(brutus)` guard after the wait
  (same reap race already guarded in `new_death`).
- **Paradise-Brutus drop-in** (`_acc_boss_brutus.gsc`): the retry `while` condition read `self.origin`
  before its inner liveness check and re-evaluated after a `wait(0.2)`; a mid-drop-in kill threw.
  Hoisted `isalive(self)` into the condition.
- **Mystery-box weight hook** (`_acc_map_randomizer.gsc::acc_box_only_weapon_keys`): runs as
  `level.CustomRandomWeaponWeights` on the spinning player with no disconnect endon in the stock box
  thread; a mid-spin disconnect threw on the `self.*` access. Added `isdefined(self)` bail.
- **`endon` poisoning of shared/boss/level threads** (thread-safety class): several synchronous
  helpers did `self endon("disconnect"/"death")` but are CALLED INLINE from long-lived threads, so
  the end-condition bound to the caller and silently killed it when the referenced player left / entity
  died. Removed the poison (helpers have no wait; the timed parts are in separately-threaded
  `*_slow_clear` fns that keep their own endons): `_acc_elites.gsc` `acc_phantom_chain_zap` /
  `acc_protector_zap` / `acc_avogadro_zap` (bound to boss attack loops), `_acc_mega_bottles.gsc`
  `armory_refill` (bound to the level round-refill watcher - one Mule-Mega holder leaving killed
  refills for the whole lobby), `zm_genesis_apothicon_fury.gsc` `apothicon_fury_spawn` (bound to the
  per-player fury timer).
- **Trench Warden Thundergun mark leak** (`_acc_damage.gsc`): the warden damage gate returned 0 before
  the one-shot Thundergun exact-damage mark was consumed, leaking the mark to a later in-trench hit
  (returned verbatim as 5-9% of boss maxhealth, defeating the fight gate). Now clears the mark in the gate.

Second pass (lean discovery audit of the previously un-swept surface - LUI, uncovered modules,
cross-cutting; each fix verified against the current source before applying):
- **hudelem pool-exhaustion class, remaining live create sites** - the shared server hudelem pool is
  fixed-size; `hud::create*` returns undefined when full (a demonstrated 4p condition) and the field
  writes that follow throw. Guarded every LIVE create that was still bare: trench danger warning
  (`_acc_bus_trench.gsc`), boss-item implant/carry HUD (`_acc_boss_items.gsc`), Mega-perk glow badge
  (`_acc_mega_bottles.gsc`), the Aetherium-mode round counter (`_acc_health_bars.gsc` - the guard covered
  only setPoint, not the following field writes), the Paradise win banner + fade-to-black (`_acc_paradise.gsc`,
  which fire when the pool is most saturated), and the proximity buy-card sub-elements (`_acc_ui.gsc`).
  (The retired roster / player-bar / own-stats / 2D-boss-bar / zombie-marker creates are dormant in
  publish - Aetherium HUD hardcoded on - so they can't be hit.)
- **Companion robot revive - player-disconnect crashes** (`archetype_zod_companion.gsc`): the revive
  sequence and its monitor loop dereferenced the downed `player` across several waits with no disconnect
  guard; a player leaving mid-revive threw "not an entity" and ended the match. Added `player
  endon("disconnect")` to the revive thread, a disconnect check + robot-state cleanup in the monitor,
  a nav-fallback so `setGoal` never runs on an undefined destination, and an `isdefined(entity.leader)`
  guard in the movement logic (leader-relative movement derefed a disconnected leader).
- **Companion robot spawn** (`zm_zod_robot.gsc`): `spawnFromSpawner` return used unguarded; a pool-full
  spawn failure threw on the next field write. Guarded.
- **Data Shards grant on a not-yet-initialized player** (`_acc_data_shards.gsc`): `grant_player` did
  arithmetic on `player.acc_data_shards` without the isdefined guard its `try_spend`/`get_count` siblings
  use; a Reactor Surge / drop targeting a mid-game joiner threw. Guarded (init to 0).
- **Electric Cherry nova on a boss** (`_acc_perk_electric_cherry.gsc`): the boss-stun guard correctly
  skipped the freeze for bosses but still threaded `electric_cherry_shock_fx`, which blocks on a
  `stun_fx_end` notify that only the (skipped) stun fires - hanging one thread and leaving the shock-eye
  FX stuck on for every EC reload near a boss. Now runs the FX only for non-bosses.
- **Client HUD uimodel callback** (`_zm_aetherium_hud.csc`): `set_ui_model_value` built a uimodel from
  `getuimodelforcontroller` without guarding an undefined root (join/first-snapshot), faulting the client
  UI. Guarded.
- **Verified clean (no fix needed):** all registered damage callbacks (`on_player_damaged`,
  `on_ai_damage`, `rp_damage_probe`, `phd_damage_override`, `zod_robot_player_damage_override`,
  `avogadro_damage_callback`) correctly guard attacker/self and honor the return contract.
- **NOT fixed - flagged for in-game testing:** three LUI state-pool-*pressure* items (per-kill kill-feed
  handler re-registration, per-damage-event plus-points popups, powerup-notification queue backlog) are
  self-clearing malfunction-severity, not the confirmed prior crash (the powerup UITimer leak, already
  fixed 2026-07-04). A blind LUI edit risks an on-screen UI Error for all players, so these need a live
  4p test to fix safely rather than an unverifiable change before publish.

### Added â€” HAVOC v4.2: hold-to-charge with release-to-CANCEL (+ riser stops on release) (user, 2026-07-06)

"Force holding it down to charge rather than a single click... If i let go mid charge the sfx should stop."
The engine LATCHES a fire tap: one click runs the full `fireDelay` wind-up and fires even after release.
`_acc_havoc_charge.gsc` is revived as a **charge-intent monitor** (v4) â€” input watching + cancel only,
NO def swaps ever (the v1/v2 lesson): on release before the wind-up completes (and before any shot) it
(1) `StopLocalSound`s the riser instantly (stock lockon-seeker recipe), (2) same-weapon
`SwitchToWeaponImmediate` snaps the anim/state to idle (same def â€” not the banned twin-style swap),
Hold-to-completion behavior is untouched engine v3 (riser climax on first shot, sustained auto, re-wind
per pull). **v4.1 (same day): clip-zero net removed** (visible 0 invited reloads) â€” but live test PROVED the latch survives release AND the same-weapon switch reset ("my gun will still shoot a shot after the 1.25s"), so **v4.2/v4.3 bring the dry-fire net back with SURGICAL timing**: the clip AND RESERVE are zeroed only for a ~250ms window BRACKETING the exact latch instant (press+1.25s âˆ’100/+150ms) â€” the phantom shot dry-fires into it, the counter is untouched otherwise (v4.2 zeroed only the clip and the phantom AUTO-RELOADED - the trigger is clip==0 && stock>0, so v4.3 zeros the reserve too = plain dry click). No reload bait, no ammo-loss races; tap-spam merges into one covering window (gun reads 0/0 during spam, dry-clicks, self-restores ~1.4s after the last tap); restore is MAX-AMMO-SAFE (a refill landing inside the window is never clobbered - restore takes the larger reserve); instant restore on switch/death.

### Fixed â€” Apex guns dead at runtime: the baked `_zm` is the MODE SUFFIX the engine strips (user, 2026-07-06)

The 5 Apex guns compiled + packed cleanly but never appeared in-game (no box rolls, no dev Alternator) â€” and
PaP'ing the Alternator Com_ERROR'd the game to desktop (no OS crash record = controlled engine abort, not a
native crash). In-game name-probe diag (persistent dev HUD; BO3's own `logfile` writes NOTHING on this box â€”
the game dir under `Program Files (x86)` isn't writable unelevated) proved the root cause: **the pack's baked
`_zm` in the ASSET id (`apex_alternator_zm`) is the ZM session-mode suffix, which the engine strips at
registration â€” the RUNTIME name is `apex_alternator`** (`GetWeapon("apex_alternator")`=OK,
`GetWeapon("apex_alternator_zm")`=none; this is exactly why stock BO3 weapon names are "never `<name>_zm`").
Every runtime reference asked for the `_zm` names, so `GetWeapon` returned weaponNone everywhere at once â€”
and the CSV's `apex_<gun>_zm_up` upgrade names meant PaP resolved a null weapon â†’ the crash.

Fix (systematic rename; ASSET ids keep `_zm`, RUNTIME refs drop it):
- `_up` GDT blocks renamed `apex_<gun>_zm_up` â†’ **`apex_<gun>_up_zm`** (runtime `apex_<gun>_up`, stock-convention;
  regenerated `acc_apex_up.gdt` via scratchpad gen_apex_up.js) + matching `.zone` weapon lines.
- Runtime name-space stripped to `apex_<gun>` / `apex_<gun>_up` in: `zm_levelcommon_weapons.csv` (both columns),
  `_acc_map_randomizer` (box pool + weights), `_acc_pap_levels` (price buckets + beam-rifle tier-3 visibility),
  `_acc_damage` (balance mults + Peacekeeper headshot/pellet), `_acc_overclocks`/`_acc_weapon_abilities` lists,
  `_acc_dev` (Alternator dev-give), `AetheriumWeapons.lua` icon keys, and the 3 generators
  (compute_gun_tiers / gen_box_dynamic / gen_weapon_stats â€” the latter keeps GDT BLOCK ids for its `up:` reads).
- Zone also gains the pack-Readme-required `xmodel,glass_ammo{,_smaller,_bigger}` UI3D meshes.

### Fixed â€” Avogadro round 2 (same-day playtest with the new diagnostics): off-navmesh machine goals = stood still + never hacked; seek ping-pong; slow attack (2026-07-06)

The new `[AVO]` heartbeat nailed it: `moved=0` all game with `path=move allowed` while `goal=machine:*` â€” plus a
wwâ†”jugg SEEK/TIMEOUT loop and `bolt=los` starvation. Three fixes:

- **Machine goals were off the navmesh** (`cache_target_origins`): the vending-machine ENTITY origin sits inside the
  machine geometry at z=60 â€” never on the navmesh â€” so `SetGoal` silently failed and he couldn't path at all (the
  9 s seek timeout always fired at full distance; **no hacks ever**). All cached targets (4 perks + PaP) are now
  projected with `GetClosestPointOnNavMesh(origin, 256, 34)` (`nav_project`, the `nsz_brutus.gsc:246` recipe); a
  target with no navmesh within 256 u logs a red warning at init.
- **Seek ping-pong starved the chase fallback** (`hack_director`): re-picking the nearest machine every 0.4 s tick +
  an 8 s blacklist (shorter than the 9 s timeout) alternated wwâ†”jugg forever, resetting the timeout timer each flip â€”
  the "chase players" fallback lasted exactly one tick all game. Now the seek is **sticky** (commits to one machine
  until arrival/timeout/invalid), a timeout blacklists for **30 s** (`acc_avo_seek_blacklist_ms`) and opens a **12 s
  pure-chase window** (`acc_avo_chase_after_timeout_ms`). Player chase is now the BT target service's **entity** goal
  (auto-tracking; `acc_avo_seek` is set only for machine goals) instead of a 0.4 s-stale position.
- **Attack speed** (user: "he attacks so slow"): dropped the pack's Â±50 u lateral facing-rect from
  `avoCanSeeBoltTarget` (an orbiting player almost never sat in that strip â†’ the run's constant `bolt=los`; the

### Fixed â€” Avogadro boss: BT-freeze (never walks), dead bolt branch (invisible attack), synced bolt rework + full dev diagnostics (user playtest, 2026-07-06)

Playtest report: "stunning me but his animation didn't line up with the logs and sfx", "I don't even see his lightning
bolt projectile", "I never saw him walk", "I don't think he turned off perks". Root causes found + fixed:

- **THE freeze/no-walk bug â€” unregistered BT condition** (`_zm_ai_avogadro.gsc`): the pack behavior tree
  (`zm_avogadro.ai_bt`, `shootgroundtorpedobehavior`) gates the bolt attack on `condition_script_negate:
  ShouldDopunchAttack` â€” a script function the pack GSC **never registered** (not stock either). An unregistered BT
  scriptFunction can never pass, so the bolt branch was dead (throw anim + `avo_send_bolt` notify never fired), and
  because BOTH `movebehavior` and `idlebehavior` require NOT-`avoShouldShootBolt`, the whole BT deadlocked whenever the
  bolt wanted to fire â†’ he **froze in place** (mid-range engaged with LOS = exactly a player fighting him). Fix: register
  a `false` stub (no punch attack exists) â€” the negate gate now passes, reviving both the bolt and movement.
- **Stale `.enemy` while machine-seeking** (`avogadrotargetservice`): the `acc_avo_seek` override early-returned BEFORE
  the closest-player bookkeeping, so `.enemy`/`.favoriteenemy` went stale/undefined nearly always (hack_director sets a
  goal every 0.4 s) â€” silently starving `avoShouldShootBolt` (needs `entity.enemy`) and `OrientMode("face enemy")`.
  Enemy upkeep now runs unconditionally; only the SetGoal target switches (machine vs player).
- **Attack rework â€” anim + SFX + bolt + stun are now ONE event** (`_acc_boss_avogadro.gsc`): the old `fire_loop` stunned
  from a bare 0.6 s timer (no anim, no projectile â€” the reported desync). Now the BT throw anim's GDT notetrack
  (`avo_send_bolt` @ frame 20) drives `bolt_listener` â†’ visible bolt projectile (script_model + the pack's `avogadro_fx`
  crackling-orb clientfield, warp-in/out SFX bracketing launch/impact) flies to a slightly-led aim point
  (`acc_avo_bolt_speed` 1100, `acc_avo_bolt_lead` 0.25) and applies the 0-dmg 30% slow **on impact**
  (`acc_avo_bolt_hit_radius` 130) â€” dodgeable. Cadence `acc_avo_bolt_cd` 3 s (replaces the pack's hardcoded 20 s in
  `avoFinishBoltShoot`). Point-blank `aura_loop` (`acc_avo_fire_interval` 0.8, â‰¤`acc_avo_aura_range` 220) covers the
  bolt's 150 u minimum. `bolt_watchdog` falls back to direct zaps ONLY on a genuine starvation bug (logs the gate).
- **Dev diagnostics for the next playtest** (dev/`acc_avo_debug`): machine-cache dump at init (proves which perk/PaP
  machines he can hack, flags NOT FOUND), SEEK/SEEK-TIMEOUT events, BOLT thrown/HIT/MISSED, aura zaps, and an enriched
  2.5 s heartbeat: `pos moved goal dist path gait enemy bolt-gate/cooldown mine tot` + a `STUCK?` flag (goal >100 u away
  but <10 u moved) â€” `avoShouldShootBolt` records its block reason (`none/cooldown/range/los/no_enemy`) every BT eval so
  the log says exactly what gates the attack. console_mp.log after a run now fully describes his state.
- Docs: 11_enemies.md (attack + bug-fix notes), 34_flags_reference.md (new `acc_avo_bolt_*` / `acc_avo_aura_range`
  dvars, repurposed `acc_avo_fire_interval`/`acc_avo_fire_range`).

### Fixed â€” Bus-trench BRIDGE: anti-camp drain took ZERO damage (self-attacker MOD dropped by stock filter) (user, 2026-07-05)

Standing on the zombie-unreachable 2x-jump bridge, the player took **no damage** â€” the anti-camp drain
(`_acc_bus_trench::bridge_drain_watcher`, "bleed 15%/s while camping") never landed, so the bridge was a free
safe-camp. This had survived **~4 prior fix attempts**, all of which moved the *detection box* (z-window). A
4-agent adversarial workflow found the box was **never** the fault.

- **Root cause (verified against stock `_zm.gsc`):** the bleed passed the **player as its own attacker** â€”
  `self DoDamage( dmg, self.origin, self, self, 0, "MOD_UNKNOWN" )`. Stock `Callback_PlayerDamage`
  (`_zm.gsc:1424-1448`) has a **self-inflicted-damage MOD whitelist**: when the attacker `isPlayer` + same team
  + `== self`, it **returns without applying damage** unless the MOD is one of GRENADE / GRENADE_SPLASH /
  EXPLOSIVE / PROJECTILE / PROJECTILE_SPLASH / BURNED / SUICIDE. `MOD_UNKNOWN` is **not** on that list, so every
  tick was silently dropped **before** any `overridePlayerDamage` / `register_player_damage_callback` ran â€” which
  is exactly why moving the box never helped, and why the earlier audits of the override chain came up clean.
- **Fix:** pass an **undefined attacker/inflictor** so the `isPlayer(eAttacker)` block is skipped and the hit
  proceeds, while **keeping `MOD_UNKNOWN`** (so PhD Flopper / all perks still can't negate the camp bleed). Stock
  precedent for source-less damage: `_oob.gsc:308`, `zombie_vortex.gsc:353`; in-repo precedent: the
  decontamination seal `_acc_decontamination.gsc:392` downs players the same undefined-attacker way.
  `self DoDamage( dmg, self.origin, undefined, undefined, 0, "MOD_UNKNOWN" )`.
- **Also:** lowered `ACC_BRIDGE_Z_MIN` 50â†’**20** (defense-in-depth jitter/mantle margin â€” nothing is standable
  between the `z=58` deck and the negative-z trench in that XY column, so it can't catch a trench camper; `z_max`
  stays 178). Detection already worked at 50; this is belt-and-suspenders, not the fix.
- **Sibling defect fixed too (user: "fix this"):** `apply_fall_tax` had the identical shape â€” self-attacker +
  `MOD_FALLING` (also not whitelisted) â€” so the 25 trench fall-tax had silently been doing nothing. Same fix
  (undefined attacker, keep `MOD_FALLING` so PhD Flopper still negates the tax for free): the jump-in tax now
  actually applies to non-PhD players. **Then tuned (user 2026-07-05):** value **25â†’35**
  (`ACC_TRENCH_FALL_DMG`), and added a **~0.2s delay** (`ACC_TRENCH_FALL_DELAY`, new threaded
  `apply_fall_tax_delayed`) so the hit lands on floor **impact** rather than mid-air on the entry frame (the
  watcher flags entry the instant the feet cross the lip, while still falling).
- Build: `-GscOnly` â†’ **BUILD OK**, fresh `.ff` synced. GSC-only. Doc: [48_abyss_descent.md](docs/48_abyss_descent.md).
  Memory: `stock-self-damage-mod-whitelist`.

The user reported "huge UI banners" appearing during **normal (non-dev) play**. A full audit (121 on-screen
`IPrintLnBold`/`IPrintLn` calls + the LUI/client surface, adversarially verified) found **5 real leaks** that
fired with `acc_dev 0`, all now gated behind `IS_TRUE( level.acc_dev )` (silent in normal play, visible in dev):

- [`_acc_bus_trench.gsc`](scripts/zm/zm_abandoned_cyber_city/_acc_bus_trench.gsc) â€” the `[BRIDGE] x/y/z` readout
  (`bridge_debug_readout`) was `IPrintLnBold`ing **every 0.25 s** while a player stood in the trench (a core
  rewarded area); its own comment said "TEMP DIAG â€¦ REMOVE once pinned." Thread spawn now gated on `acc_dev`.
- [`_zm_ai_avogadro.gsc`](scripts/zm/zm_abandoned_cyber_city/_zm_ai_avogadro.gsc) `avo_log` â€” the `[AVO]` spawn-step
  diagnostics fired ~7 lines to every player per Avogadro spawn; its guard `level.avo_no_log` was **never assigned**,
  so it was effectively always-on. Now `!IS_TRUE(level.acc_dev) && getdvarint("acc_avo_debug",0)!=1` returns early.
- [`_acc_boss_avogadro.gsc`](scripts/zm/zm_abandoned_cyber_city/_acc_boss_avogadro.gsc) â€” the `HACKED:` / `RESTORED:`
  `announce()` banners fired on every machine hack during an Avogadro fight; gated on `acc_dev` (the normal-play tell
  is the machine glow going dark).

Per the user's directive ("it should ONLY be behind the dev flag â€” that's the only flag I care about"), the **15
debug channels** that were gated behind separate `acc_*_debug` dvars were **folded under `acc_dev`** as the master
switch (`he_log`/`drops_debug`/`crash_log`, `gdebug`, `pdebug`, `warden_debug`, perk-lights `dbg`, `ld_debug`,
`ldc_debug`, `dmg_debug_probe`, three `acc_mega_flopper_debug` sites, the `acc_variants_debug` swap print, and NSZ's
`nsz_iprintlnbold`): each is now `( IS_TRUE(level.acc_dev) || <its dvar> )`, so `acc_dev 1` enables them all and
`acc_dev 0` silences them all â€” the per-channel dvar stays only as an optional narrow filter. A case-insensitive
sweep for lowercase `iprintln` leaks found none remaining. **Left as intended gameplay (still show in normal play):**
the lockdown-challenge `ldc_announce` banners + `GLITCH PURGE` counter, all purchase/unlock/boss-approach/EE/perk-cap
feedback, and `BRUTUS INBOUND` (behind the deliberate `acc_test_boss` force-spawn toggle, not a leak). `lint_gsc_xref`
clean; GSC-only â†’ linker-only rebuild. Docs: [docs/34 Â§E](docs/34_flags_reference.md).

### Changed â€” Avogadro final tuning + boss stun â†’ 30% + ship cleanup for publish (user 2026-07-05)

Final pass on the Avogadro cyberhacker and a global boss-stun bump, then reverted all test hardcodes for a
**real non-dev / non-god / no-mocks publish run**.

- **Boss stun unified to âˆ’30%** (was âˆ’25%): `acc_phantom_slow_mult` / `acc_protector_slow_mult` /
  `acc_avogadro_slow_mult` default `0.75 â†’ 0.70` in `recompute_move_speed`. **Mega Electric Cherry** still
  softens it, and since the softening is a **flat âˆ’10% floor** (`acc_boss_slow_mega_mult 0.90`), Mega EC now
  brings the âˆ’30% stun down to **âˆ’10%** (you keep 90% speed instead of 70%). Clarified: the slow comes from the
  **shot** (his attack), not proximity â€” same as the other bosses; if he's hacked your EC off, the softening
  naturally stops.
- **Per-boss hack ownership (multi-Avogadro, round 18+):** the 2-machine hack cap is now **per-boss**, so two
  Avogadros can disable up to **4** machines (all 4 perks) between them ("doubly lethal"). Each boss owns its
  hacks (`level.acc_avo_hacked_by[key]` = the boss's `acc_avo_id`, an int â€” sidesteps the entity-compare throw)
  and restores **only its own** when it dies; a still-alive sibling keeps its hacks; the last-Avogadro death
  force-restores any residue. One machine is only hacked by one Avogadro at a time (the other seeks a different
  one). `do_hack` now takes `(boss, key)`; new `boss_hack_count()` / `restore_boss_hacks()`.
- **Weak to melee:** a knife now does **1/100 of his max HP**, so **exactly 100 knives kill him at any round**
  (`acc_avo_knife_hits`, default 100) â€” replaces the old flat 3Ã— multiplier.
- **Zap now reads as an attack:** a visible tesla bolt fires from his hand toward the target + an electric flash
  lands on the target; fire rate slowed `0.33 â†’ 0.6 s` (~1.6/sec) so each zap is a distinct event. Dropped the
  LOS gate that was suppressing fire.
- **Walk-to-machines:** `hack_director` seeks the nearest enabled machine (perks first) and hacks it in range,
  falling back to chasing the nearest player when none is reachable or he's at his cap. Gait dialed back
  **sprint â†’ run** (`acc_avo_gait`).

### Fixed â€” Kill feed printed raw `ZM_AETHERIUM_KF_*` tokens: TWO layered bugs (missing header + double-prefixed keys) (user 2026-07-04/05)

The kill feed rendered raw localization tokens ("ZM_AETHERIUM_KF_MELEE" â€¦) instead of text ("Melee Kill" â€¦). It had
**worked in the original Owen-C137 kit** and regressed in our map. Root cause was two stacked bugs in
[`localizedstrings/zm_aetherium.str`](localizedstrings/zm_aetherium.str), the second of which was masked by the first:

1. **Missing StringEd header â†’ zero strings compiled.** The file's `VERSION "1"` block had been lost (and a first fix
   then placed it *below* a `//` comment banner, so `VERSION` wasn't line 1 either). The T7 string compiler needs
   `VERSION` as the **literal first line**; anything above it (comment or blank line) makes it parse zero strings, so
   every key falls through to its raw token. Fixed by rewriting to pure StringEd form â€” `VERSION` line 1, no comments.
2. **Double-prefixed reference keys (the real regression).** With the header fixed, the strings compiled â€” but the
   **T7 compiler auto-prepends the `.str` filename** (`zm_aetherium` â†’ `ZM_AETHERIUM_`) to every `REFERENCE`. A prior
   "rename the keys to match the GSC" fix had changed the kit's bare `KF_MELEE` keys to `ZM_AETHERIUM_KF_MELEE`, so the
   compiled key became `ZM_AETHERIUM_` + `ZM_AETHERIUM_KF_MELEE` = **`ZM_AETHERIUM_ZM_AETHERIUM_KF_MELEE`**. The game
   asks for `ZM_AETHERIUM_KF_MELEE`, which no longer existed â†’ raw token. Fix: reverted the `REFERENCE` keys to **bare
   `KF_*`** (as the kit shipped them); the filename auto-prefix reconstitutes `ZM_AETHERIUM_KF_*`, matching the GSC.

**Verified by decompressing the built `en_zm_abandoned_cyber_city.ff`** (block-zlib; tool in scratchpad): the string
table now contains `ZM_AETHERIUM_KF_MELEE â†’ "Melee Kill"` (single prefix), no `ZM_AETHERIUM_ZM_AETHERIUM_*` remaining.
Diagnosis also confirmed the game loads the **usermaps** copy via the `<game>\usermaps` junction (sound-bank path in
`console_mp.log`), not the stale Steam-Workshop subscription copy. GSC/LUI/zone untouched; `.str`-only â†’ linker rebuild.
Doc: [28_lui_pipeline.md](docs/28_lui_pipeline.md).

### Changed â€” Weapon stats doc is now GENERATED + self-checking; PaP damage figures corrected (user 2026-07-04)

The weapon-stats doc kept drifting because it was hand-maintained across 4 conflicting sources (live GDT, the pricing
tool, stale code comments, old snapshots). Two audits (one agent per gun reading the deployed GDT directly; then a fresh
generator) exposed that **even `audit_gun_damage.js` was wrong for PaP**: it used each gun's *base* raw damage Ã— a flat
ladder, but the real PaP weapon is the GDT `_up` entry with its **own** (different) raw damage â€” so every PaP-damage
figure was off (e.g. AK-47 base raw 200 but `_up` raw 270; Paladin base 1000 but `_up` 2000).

- **New generator [tools/gen_weapon_stats.js](tools/gen_weapon_stats.js)** reads the LIVE deployed GDT `_up` entries
  (raw/clipSize/maxAmmo/locHead) + `_acc_damage.gsc` (bal, global 3.25, headshot Ã—0.5) + `_acc_pap_levels.gsc` (PaP
  ladder Ã—1.333/1.667/2.0) and emits [docs/41](docs/41_weapon_stats_table.md). Verified formula:
  `PaP body(T) = round(raw_up Ã— bal Ã— 3.25 Ã— papMult(T))`, `head = body Ã— (locHeadÃ—0.5)` (Ã—2.5 std / Ã—2.0 Mahem /
  shotguns excluded), `reserve = clipSize Ã— maxAmmo`.
- **Full-proof self-checks** (so nothing slips past): aborts if any roster gun can't resolve a real `_up` GDT entry;
  every parsed constant is **range-bounded** (this caught a regex that grabbed `tier_cost`'s `return 10000` instead of
  `pap_tier_mult`'s `1.999999`); cross-derives each body two ways; asserts the ladder is monotonic; locates each GDT file
  by scanning for the entry (rename-proof). `--check` mode gates without writing. The generated numbers match the
  independent per-gun GDT verification exactly.
- **docs/41 rewritten as a GENERATED file** ("do NOT hand-edit; regenerate with `node tools/gen_weapon_stats.js`").
  ASM1 excluded (retired); Thundergun/Action Figure listed as specials (no standard PaP single-shot).
- **`audit_gun_damage.js`** now prints a warning that its PaP columns are approximate/superseded (its base-form columns
  stay correct). NOTE: several `acc_weapon_balance_mult` code comments still cite stale clip/reserve numbers â€” the GDT +
  docs/41 are ground truth; the comments are cosmetic and left for a later cleanup.

### Fixed â€” Kill feed printed raw `ZM_AETHERIUM_KF_*` tokens: the `.str` was missing its header (user 2026-07-04)

The Aetherium kill feed rendered the **raw localization token** ("ZM_AETHERIUM_KF_CRITICAL", â€¦) instead of the
text ("Critical Kill", â€¦). Root cause: [`localizedstrings/zm_aetherium.str`](localizedstrings/zm_aetherium.str)
had **no StringEd header** â€” it started directly at `REFERENCE` (the closing `ENDMARKER` survived, the top
`VERSION`/`CONFIG`/`FILENOTES` block did not, lost when the file was first split out of the kit). BO3's T7 string
compiler requires `VERSION "1"` first; without it it parses **zero** strings, so every key falls through to its raw
token. Everything else in the chain was already correct â€” GSC keys, `#precache`, the 15 `LANG_ENGLISH` values, the
zone `localize,zm_aetherium` line, and the LUI `Engine.Localize(Engine.GetIString(...))` render. The earlier
"rename the keys to match" fix (prior entry) was necessary but couldn't take effect until the header was restored.
Fix: re-added the canonical header. GSC/LUI untouched. Doc: [28_lui_pipeline.md](docs/28_lui_pipeline.md).

### Fixed â€” "Failed to allocate from state pool" crash (round 26, 4p) + gradual frame decay = Aetherium HUD UITimer leaks (user 2026-07-04)

A 4-player game slowly lost frames all game and died at round 26 with the engine fatal **"Failed to allocate from
state pool"**. Multi-agent hunt + a dedicated LUI-lifecycle audit (diffed against Owen-C137's original kit â€” the bugs
are KIT-INHERITED, byte-identical upstream; they arrived when the Aetherium HUD became the base HUD 2026-07-03, which
is why old versions didn't leak). Root cause: **never-closed `LUI.UITimer` elements** â€” LUI timers keep firing until
explicitly closed, so every one left behind is a live element burning state-pool entries and CPU forever:

- **[AetheriumPowerupNotification.lua](ui/uieditor/widgets/HUD/AetheriumWidgets/AetheriumPowerupNotification.lua)
  (the round-26 fatal):** every powerup pickup leaked a repeating 3000ms "hold" timer whose handler re-played the
  hide animation AND `addElement`'d ANOTHER never-closed 300ms timer every 3s â€” a COMPOUNDING cascade
  (pickups Ã— elapsed/3s â‡’ tens of thousands of leaked elements by late game). Fixed: one handle per timer role,
  close-before-create + close-inside-handler (fires exactly once).
- **[AetheriumLoadout.lua](ui/uieditor/widgets/HUD/AetheriumWidgets/AetheriumLoadout.lua) (the frame decay):**
  2 leaked timers per weapon SWITCH (grenade throws toggle the viewmodel weapon twice!) â€” ~600-1500 dead timers by
  round 26, each dispatching every ~100-130ms. Same fix pattern on both (icon + name swap timers).
- **[AetheriumPlayerInfo.lua](ui/uieditor/widgets/HUD/AetheriumWidgets/AetheriumPlayerInfo.lua) (latent, hardened):**
  the 7 per-score-type popup subscriptions were installed inside an unguarded `linkToElementModel("clientNum")` â€”
  a re-fire (roster change/fastRestart) would add them AGAIN â†’ N popups per score event. Guarded per-clientNum.
  (The popup close-chain itself was audited SOUND â€” create-per-event + clip_over close is the vanilla pattern.)
- **[_acc_atmosphere.gsc](scripts/zm/zm_abandoned_cyber_city/_acc_atmosphere.gsc) (log hygiene, NOT the leak):**
  the fog authority loop re-issued the deprecated 8-arg `SetVolFog` with identical args 10Ã—/sec forever
  (~24,000 calls + "setVolFog: Old syntax used" lines per match, burying the real fatal in console_mp.log).
  Now CHANGE-GATED via `acc_set_vol_fog()` (the vision loop's wantâ‰ applied pattern) â€” engine called only when a
  fog param actually changes. Verified a pure global-state setter (stock _art.gsc runs the same 0.1s loop): noise, not the pool leak.
- Also: Rogue Protector `StopLoopSound()` on death (hover-hum otherwise looped on the corpse forever; bounded, polish).

Ruled out along the way (adversarially verified): fury looping-FX (stock-identical, alloc/free balanced, 8-cap),
UI-model names (all fixed), octobomb cap loop, debt directors (spend-down verified). `-GscOnly`, BUILD OK.

### Fixed â€” Li'l Arnie (octobomb) Ã— Brutus co-op crash + hardened the whole octobombâ†”boss surface (user 2026-07-03)

Root-caused a 4-player round-8 crash (heavy Li'l Arnie use with Brutus alive) to a **mutate-during-foreach**
in the NSZ Brutus pack. `nsz_brutus.gsc::remove_brutus` is registered as `level.octobomb_targets` and invoked by
stock `_zm_weap_octobomb.gsc` every targeting cycle (`do_tentacle_burst`/`do_tentacle_grab`) as
`[[ level.octobomb_targets ]]( <full zombie array> )`. The pack body did
`foreach( zom in ai ) ArrayRemoveValue( ai, zom, false );` â€” **mutating the array it was iterating** (T7 GSC
iterator-invalidation = UB) **and returning nothing** (caller then fed `undefined` into `ArraySortClosest`). Both
branches are inert until an `is_boss` actor is in the zombie array, so they fire the instant Brutus is present; with
many octobombs across 4 players the targeting cycle runs constantly â†’ crash. A multi-agent adversarial sweep
(GSC-only, `-GscOnly`, BUILD OK) confirmed this was the ONLY live `ArrayRemoveValue`-on-iterated-array in the tree,
plus three related hazards â€” all fixed:

- **`remove_brutus` (the crash):** rebuilt to return a NEW array of non-boss, defined-only AI; never touches the
  input array. Fixes both the mutate-during-foreach AND the undefined return.
- **Octobomb boss filter was half-fixed:** it excluded only `.is_boss`, but the Phantom / Glitch Stalker /
  Juggernaut Host / Paradise host set only `.acc_is_mini_boss` and the Subroutine Core only `.acc_is_boss` â€” so
  octobombs still `octo_gib`/`StartRagdoll`/`DoDamage(health)`'d those **live** mini-bosses (instakill + ragdoll of a
  boss running scripted ASM = gameplay break + entity-corruption risk). `remove_brutus` now excludes
  `is_boss || acc_is_boss || acc_is_mini_boss`.
- **Thread-storm cap (`_acc_boss_items.gsc::scale_octobombs_watch`):** stock re-threads per-target infect/explode
  every cycle (its dedup checks `b_octobomb_infected`, which normal zombies never set), so 4p Ã— 4-ammo Ã— dense horde
  can balloon into a frame-starving thread/clientfield storm. Added a **total live-octobomb cap** (`acc_arnie_max_live`,
  default 8) that force-detonates the oldest excess through their OWN stock `"explode"` path (self-cleans; never a raw
  `Delete`). Live-tunable; `0` disables.
- **`watch_for_machines` latent hang:** its `while(1)` yielded only inside a `for` over `brutus_lock` structs (none
  exist on this map) â€” a hard hang if ever threaded. Inert today (`brutus_lock_machines` hardcoded false) but the file
  header warns about it; added an unconditional `wait(0.05)` + empty-array `continue` so it's no longer a landmine.

`-GscOnly`, BUILD OK (fresh `.ff`). The refuted 5th finding (`new_death` `%brutus_death` anim guard) only bites a
fastfile built without the NSZ GDT imported (not our case), so left as-is.

### Fixed â€” Apothicon Fury never spawned in the trench: the enabled-zone gate rejected every below-volume spot (user 2026-07-03)

The REAL root cause (the 8s-arm change made the timer fire, but the spawn itself still failed): the user
confirmed furies dropped fine at Plaza but never in the trench. `_acc_fury::spawn_fury_near` filtered each
navmesh candidate through `zm_utility::check_point_in_enabled_zone(origin, 1)` â€” and the deep trench floor
(z âˆ’240 and lower) sits **below every zone's `player_volume`** (corp_zone spans only z[-16,400]), so that
check returns FALSE for **every** trench point and rejected all 20 candidates. The surface (Plaza) spawn
worked because it IS inside an enabled zone. Fix: **skip the enabled-zone check on the underground path**
(`require_underground`) â€” the navmesh query is already centered on a valid deep player and returns pathable
ground, and the pack's `apothicon_fury_spawn` force-sets `completed_emerging_into_playable_area = 1`, so a
below-volume spawn is not OOB-killed or melee-locked (the SAME below-zone fix the trench *surge* uses). The
surface dev force-spawn (`acc_fury_spawn 1`, `require_underground=false`) still gates on the enabled zone.
`-GscOnly`, BUILD OK. Memory: `below-zone-trench-spawn-skips-enabled-zone-check`.

### Changed â€” Multi-boss rounds + boss stun softened by Mega Electric Cherry (user 2026-07-03)

**Multi-boss rounds that scale with the round.** A boss ROUND still lands every 9 rounds from round 9
(dev: every 3 from round 3), but the COUNT now scales: **round 9 = 1 boss, 18 = 2, 27 = 3, â€¦** (slot+1).
**Each** boss that round is an INDEPENDENT coin flip â€” Phantom or Rogue Protector â€” so a round can be
one-of-each, all Phantoms, all Rogue Protectors, or any mix (replaces the old alternating single-boss
rotation). **Boss music holds until every boss that round is dead** (the `acc_boss::boss_music` refcount
already did this per-actor â€” each boss threads it). Implementation: `_acc_civil_protector` owns a shared
per-round **roster** (`boss_count`/`boss_roster`/`boss_type_count`, published as `level.acc_boss_roster_fn`),
rolled once per round and cached on the level so both boss modules (whose `round_watch` threads fire on the
same `acc_round_start`) read an identical roster. Both directors converted from a one-at-a-time owed flag to
a **debt model** (`level.acc_phantom_debt` / `level.acc_protector_debt`): a boss round adds that type's
roster count; the director spends one spawn per tick, so a multi-boss round trickles bosses in a few seconds
apart and a failed spawn simply retries. Removed the single-instance handles `level.acc_phantom_host` /
`level.acc_robot_boss` and the one-at-a-time guards (`run_round_boss`, `which_boss`, `boss_rotation_start`
deleted). Paradise is unaffected (it spawns Phantoms on its own path via the `spawn_phantom` return value).

**Multiple Rogue Protectors are now spawn-safe.** The landing kill-splash (`landing_kill_splash`) excluded
only the boss that was landing, so on a 2+/3+ boss round two Rogue Protectors slamming down within 350u of
each other would `DoDamage` each other to death (the old self-kill loop, aimed at a sibling). It now skips
**any** actor flagged `is_boss`/`acc_is_boss`/`acc_is_mini_boss`, so no boss ever dies to another boss's
entrance (Phantom/Brutus/Subroutine Core caught in the blast are spared too). Everything else was already
per-actor (each Protector runs its own hunt/fire/zap/death threads; stun is applied per-boss in `zap_loop`;
nameplate is a per-actor clientfield).

Mega Electric Cherry "Power Surge" **no longer grants full immunity to the Phantom / Rogue Protector stun** â€”

updated.

### Fixed â€” Rogue Protector shot FX/SFX v3: CLIENT-side via a shot-pulse clientfield (user 2026-07-03)

v2's muzzle spark + zap were STILL invisible/silent â€” because **server-side PlayFX/PlaySound on
actors is dead in this build**, the same documented reason the perk glows render client-side (the
_acc_perk_lights precedent; should have been caught sooner). v3 uses the proven Phantom-aura lane:
a new 2-bit actor clientfield `acc_bnp_shot` (registered in _acc_boss_nameplate gsc+csc) that the
fire loop increments per shot via `shot_pulse(boss)`; the .csc callback plays the small spark burst
(`impacts/fx_bul_impact_concrete_sm`, client-precached) on `tag_weapon_right` + the
`acc_phantom_zap` report ON EVERY CLIENT (bInitialSnap guarded so a boss snapshotting into view
doesn't fire a phantom shot). Rule now recorded in memory: ALL runtime FX/SFX on actors must go
clientfield â†’ .csc.

### Fixed â€” Rogue Protector round-3 no-spawn: the .map spawner entities were CLOBBERED by a concurrent session (user 2026-07-02, late)

The debug instrumentation caught it in one run: `[RP] round 3 - due=YES` â†’ `[RP] FAIL: no
acc_robot_boss_spawner entity found in BSP`. TWO stacked root causes:
1. **A concurrent session's whole-file `.map` rewrite (the sky/plaza pass) silently erased ALL THREE
   appended robot spawner entities** (the ally pair + the boss spawner â€” which is also why the
   earlier ally test worked but nothing could spawn after). Re-appended with a warning comment; bake
   gate re-run (BAKED 54.4s; all 3 verified present in the compiled `.d3dbsp` by direct grep). New
   working rule (memory `concurrent-sessions-clobber-map-appends`): grep the `.map` for your entity
   markers right before every geometry build when parallel sessions are active.
2. **Spawner-classname aitype resolution needs a GDT derived-entry CHAIN**: with the entity finally
   in the BSP, the linker revealed `'spawner_acc_zod_robot_boss' is not a valid aitype asset` â€” a
   classname `actor_spawner_<X>` resolves to an aitype literally named `spawner_<X>`, which packs
   provide as empty-body GDT **derived entries**: `archetype_<X>` (full def) â† `variant_<X>` â†
   `spawner_<X>` (how the HB21 ally spawners + Brutus resolve; visible in assetinfo as BOTH

### Fixed â€” GOD MODE restored (player-damage-callback chain poisoning) + mocks off + dev boss round 3 (user 2026-07-02, late)

**God mode was dead since the Civil Protector install â€” root cause is a stock-chain contract:**
`_zm.gsc::check_player_damage_callbacks` returns the FIRST callback result **!= -1** and SKIPS all
later callbacks. The pack's `zm_zod_robot::zod_robot_player_damage_override` ends `return iDamage`
(instead of -1 = "no opinion"), and it registers at load (REGISTER_SYSTEM) â€” BEFORE `_acc_elites`'
damage handler â€” so the god-zeroing (and every per-hit effect) never ran ("I was dying in god
mode"). Fixed in the vendored copy: `return -1`. The short-lived `acc_protector_dmg_scale` callback
(same poison class) is REMOVED â€” the boss's bullet strength is now tuned at the source, in the
weapon GDT: the pack shipped **`playerDamage` 1550/3100 per bullet (instakill!)** on the companion
AR / upgraded AR â†’ **25/35** (install-side). New rule for the KB: **any registered player-damage
callback MUST return -1 on its no-opinion path.** Also: **player HUD mocks OFF everywhere** (user:
"only dev mode and god mode on" â€” `_acc_health_bars` force_mocks now hard false, dev shows only real
players) and the **dev Rogue Protector cadence moved to round 3** (was 2), still every 5.

### Fixed â€” Base RPD scope drifted off-center under fire: inverted ADS pitch (user 2026-06-29)

The base RPD's sight drifted **off-center while firing** â€” the only gun affected. Root cause: the BOCW RPD port ships a **malformed `adsGunKickPitch`** range â€” `Max = -35` **below** `Min = -10` (negative + inverted); `apply_recoil_overhaul` scaled it to `Max = -61.25` vs `Min = -17.5`, so the gun model pitched hard the **same direction every shot** â†’ the scope tilted off-center. (`symmetrize_cw_recoil.js` had centered the *yaw* but deliberately leaves pitch alone â€” a normal upward kick is fine; only this inverted range is the bug.) New [tools/fix_inverted_gunkick_pitch.js](tools/fix_inverted_gunkick_pitch.js) sets `Max = -Min` wherever the ADS gun-kick pitch range is inverted â†’ symmetric **Â±17.5** (matching the M60). Applied to the RPD's base + PaP forms, the `.acc-orig` **baseline** (so a recoil-overhaul re-run stays fixed), and its **14 twins** â€” **RPD-only, ADS-only** (hip ranges + other guns untouched; verified the broad hip-inversion matches were excluded). `gdtdb /update` + `-GscOnly` build.

### Fixed â€” Shield (Riot) elite spawned at sprint and never slowed (user 2026-06-28)

The Shielded "Riot" elite ([_acc_elites.gsc](scripts/zm/zm_abandoned_cyber_city/_acc_elites.gsc) `shielded_speed_think`) is meant to be a heavy half-pace **walker**, but it spawned faster than the horde and never changed â€” in non-god mode it clobbered the player. Root cause: a spawn-order race against a stock **override-lock**. The frame-N+1 on-spawn hook (`_acc_zombie_speed::on_zombie_spawned_speed`) writes the horde tier (`"sprint"` at round â‰¥15) into `self.zombie_move_speed_override`; stock `set_zombie_run_cycle()` then early-returns whenever that override is already defined, so the think's `set_zombie_run_cycle_override_value("walk")` was **silently dropped** and the elite kept the sprint gait at â‰¥1.0 anim rate forever. Fix: the think now **clears the override-lock then re-asserts "walk"** (mirroring `_acc_zombie_speed::apply_speed_for_round`'s clear-then-set, guarded on drift), and the keep-alive skip-flag `acc_boss_custom_speed` is set **synchronously** in `promote_to_shielded` so the spawn hook never tags the actor. `-GscOnly` build.

The Mega slide nova used to track **live** `level.zombie_health` and ran through the global Ã—2.75 buff + the
+15% Mega Flopper bonus, so it one-shot trash at **every** round ("a single slide" forever) and read ~64k vs
bosses. It now deals a **frozen** damage = a **round-16 normal-zombie's health** (solo **1851** = 950 Ã— 1.1â·;

  tag set around the `phd_explode` damage loop), so the frozen number is *exactly* what lands and can't balloon

### Fixed â€” Crash-hunt pass: co-op thread leaks, disconnect-window CTD, boss soft-lock (user, 2026-06-27)

A two-pass multi-agent crash audit of all 59 GSC/CSC modules (every finding adversarially verified) surfaced
five runtime faults; all five fixed. GSC-only â€” `-GscOnly` build.
- **Per-life thread leak (THE co-op slow-burn)** â€” [_acc_perks.gsc](scripts/zm/zm_abandoned_cyber_city/_acc_perks.gsc)
  `on_player_spawned` re-threaded `qr_regen_booster` (+ child `qr_damage_time_watcher`) and `savior_speed_watcher`
  every respawn, relying on `self endon("death")` to kill the prior life's copies â€” but a BO3 **ZM player never
  notifies `"death"`** (bleed-out routes to spectator; `"death"` only fires on disconnect). So every full-death
  respawn permanently STACKED 3 loops per player â€” duplicate per-frame `setnormalhealth` + duplicate
  `waittill("damage")` subscribers â€” growing for the whole run until the script VM degrades/exhausts (matches
  "the longer we play the worse it gets, then it dies"). Fix: `player notify("acc_perk_life")` before re-threading
  + `self endon("acc_perk_life")` on all three loops (the `acc_lui_life` per-life idiom).
- **Same leak class in the HUD** â€” [_acc_lui.gsc](scripts/zm/zm_abandoned_cyber_city/_acc_lui.gsc)
  `maxammo_flash_watch` / `nuke_flash_watch` were missing `endon("acc_lui_life")` (their parent had it), leaking
  one thread each per revive. Added the endon to both.
- **Paradise Box disconnect-window CTD** â€” [_acc_glitch_altar.gsc](scripts/zm/zm_abandoned_cyber_city/_acc_glitch_altar.gsc)
  `paradise_box_loop` runs on the box trigger (so its `endon("death")` doesn't fire on a player leaving); after the
  0.75s spin `wait` it derefed `player` (`weapon_give`/`PlaySound`/`.name`) with no re-check â€” a player disconnecting
  mid-spin â†’ method call on a freed entity â†’ whole-session co-op fatal. Added an `isdefined/is_player_valid`
  re-check across the yield (same fix as `_acc_overclocks::terminal_loop`).
- **Electric Cherry froze bosses (boss-round soft-lock)** â€” [_acc_perk_electric_cherry.gsc](scripts/zm/zm_abandoned_cyber_city/_acc_perk_electric_cherry.gsc)
  `ec_nova` dropped the stock `is_brutus` guard, so the ~4s `ignoreall` stun applied to bosses (always non-lethal
  vs the nova) â€” reloading near a boss froze it most of the round. Now skips the stun for any `acc_is_boss`/
  `acc_is_mini_boss` (bosses still take the shock FX + nova damage).
- **Brutus respawn gate stuck-guard** â€” [_acc_boss.gsc](scripts/zm/zm_abandoned_cyber_city/_acc_boss.gsc)
  `watch_mini_boss_death` cleared `acc_brutus_active` only on the `"death"` notify; if the host were ever removed
  without one, the Trench Warden could never respawn. Added `brutus_guard_failsafe` to release the gate if the
  host is freed silently. (Latent hardening â€” no known live trigger today.)

**Bug (reported live):** getting a handling perk (Mega Deadshot=recoil, Gun Slinger=fast-fire, Speed
Cola=fast-reload) swaps the held gun to a perk-**twin**, and the twins carried the **wrong ammo** â€” usually
the pristine **uncut** clip/reserve, sometimes lower. E.g. Tac-19 jumped clip 3â†’6 / reserve 27â†’72; ASM1 clip
22â†’32; RW1 was badly broken (clip 8â†’**1**, reserve 7â†’**40**). **Root cause:** `apply_recoil_overhaul.js`
generates the twins from the **pristine** base GDT, but `reduce_base_ammo.js` (+ RW1 CLIP_FIX / Olympia
MAXAMMO_FIX) only cut the **install** base/`_up` blocks â€” never the twins in `acc_weapon_variants.gdt`.

**Audited all 32 twin forms** (`scratchpad` audit) â†’ 10 guns drifted on ammo: Tac-19, ASM1, AE4, MK14,
Galil, MORS, Olympia, RW1, PPSH-41, Paladin (+ a residual Five-Seven `startAmmo`). New tool
[tools/fix_twin_ammo_drift.js](tools/fix_twin_ammo_drift.js) SETs every twin's `clipSize`/`maxAmmo`/`startAmmo`
to its canonical install form (231 fields across 147 twin blocks). Re-audit = **0 ammo drift** (only the
intentional Gun-Slinger fast-fire `fireTime` diffs remain). Damage was already consistent.

- GDT-only â†’ `gdtdb /update` (done by the tool) + `-GscOnly` linker. Clean `.ff`.
- **PIPELINE FIX (prevents recurrence):** the canonical post-port order is now
  `apply_recoil_overhaul.js â†’ reduce_base_ammo.js â†’ fix_twin_ammo_drift.js â†’ remove_ppsh_pap_optic.js â†’
  rebalance_pap_forms.js â†’ gdtdb/build`. The first two reset base + regenerate twins, so the last three
  must always re-run after them (documented in each tool header + memory `pap-per-form-stat-tuning`).

### Fixed â€” Co-op crash/lag-out audit: PaP/Overclock disconnect CTDs, PaP pre-power CTD, string-cache feeders (user, 2026-06-27)

Multi-agent crash audit (78 agents over all ~28.9k lines, every finding adversarially verified) targeting the
reported "almost every co-op session crashes or someone lags out." Applied the confirmed, reachable crash fixes
(the user-selected scope). GSC-only build OK, fresh 46 MB `.ff`.

- **Overclock terminal: disconnect-during-redraw CTD.** `terminal_loop` calls `player replay_pack_draw()`
  **inline** on the shared trigger thread (whose only `endon` is the TRIGGER's `"death"`), then reuses `player`
  on the next line. A disconnect/timeout during the multi-frame empty-handed redraw window made that a method
  call on a freed entity â†’ fatal script error â†’ whole-session CTD. Added an `isdefined(player)` re-validation
  after the redraw. [`_acc_overclocks.gsc`](scripts/zm/zm_abandoned_cyber_city/_acc_overclocks.gsc) (~L325).
- **Pack-a-Punch: same disconnect window (higher frequency than the terminal).** `acc_do_first_pack` /
  `acc_do_tier_up` run as `player thread` but lacked `self endon("disconnect")`, so a disconnect mid-pack
  resumed on a freed player (`minus_to_player_score` / `fill_full_ammo`) â†’ CTD. Added `self endon("disconnect")`
  to both (player-threaded, so the endon only aborts that player's own pack).
  [`_acc_pap_levels.gsc`](scripts/zm/zm_abandoned_cyber_city/_acc_pap_levels.gsc).
- **Pack-a-Punch before power: undefined-cost CTD.** Stock sets the PaP trigger `.cost` only after
  `Pack_A_Punch_on`, but power ships OFF behind the manual dual-switch and everyone spawns with a packable
  tier-0 gun, so the price keeper compared `t.acc_saved_cost` (= undefined `t.cost`) `< ACC_PAP_STOCK_FIRST_COST`
  â€” a relational compare on undefined = fatal â€” the moment anyone walked within 130u of PaP pre-power. Guarded
  with `isdefined(t.acc_saved_cost)` (falls through to the per-gun first-pack price). `_acc_pap_levels.gsc` (~L233).
- **String-cache (2048 'string' BG-cache) feeders â†’ gradual CTD in long games.** Two `SetText` paths embedded
  unbounded/high-cardinality numbers (each distinct string permanently burns a never-freed cache slot â€” the
  `Exceeded 2048 items for type string` class this map hit before): The Exchange deposit/withdraw toasts baked
  the ever-climbing `vault: <total>` into the text (dropped â†’ bounded per-press amount only,
  [`_acc_transfer.gsc`](scripts/zm/zm_abandoned_cyber_city/_acc_transfer.gsc)); the co-op squad roster baked the
  live shard count `[0..500]` Ã— EXO tier into 4 simultaneously-rendered rows (~5.5k possible strings) â€” floored
  the displayed shards to the nearest 10 (~561 strings) rather than adding a SetValue elem (the hudelem pool is
  already near-exhausted). [`_acc_health_bars.gsc`](scripts/zm/zm_abandoned_cyber_city/_acc_health_bars.gsc) (~L470).
- **Audit backlog (not yet applied, user-deferred):** dev+god mode is HARD-CODED on (masks the down/revive
  crash family + ship-unsafe); Reactor-surge actor-pool stall (round-freeze/lag-out, 6-actor headroom); Paradise
  `gather_stragglers` random-ring teleport stacking; and 5 latent FATALs in the disabled Avogadro module
  (gate before re-enabling). See the audit summary in conversation.

### Fixed â€” Zombies wouldn't path to the player + duplicate-Exchange-door crash (user, 2026-06-27)

Two bugs surfaced after the 08:02 plaza-shrink/Exchange `.map` rewrite. **(1) Duplicate Exchange door
crash:** the `.map` shipped the `enter_exchange` door DUPLICATED â€” two `zombie_door` trigger_use + two
`acc_door_exchange` slabs (identical GUID, a `gen_plaza_basement` copy-paste). `zone_door_buy_loop`'s

`console_mp.log`) and killed the door thread. Added `acc_dedupe_exchange_door()`
([zm_abandoned_cyber_city.gsc](scripts/zm/zm_abandoned_cyber_city.gsc), runs first in `main()` next to the PaP
dedupe) â€” renames surplus slabs off the GetEnt key and disables surplus triggers, self-heals every load.
**(2) Zombies stood still / wouldn't target the player:** the navmesh deployed at 08:03 (built right after the
geometry edit) was **bad** â€” zombies acquired the player as enemy (`e=1 fav=1`) but had **no path** to them, so
they froze ~220u away; opening the implantâ†’Exchange doors gave the navmesh its only working bridge. Root cause:
that build regenerated a botched `_navmesh.hkt`, and subsequent `-GscOnly` builds **reuse** the navmesh so they
couldn't fix it. A clean **full** `build_map.ps1` (cod2map64 with cwd=`bin` â†’ fresh BSP + navmesh + LED bake)
regenerated a correct navmesh and zombies path normally again. Diagnosed with a temporary dev `[targdbg]`
readout (player + nearest-zombie coords to `console_mp.log`), since removed. Ruled out (multi-agent + log):
god mode, Cyberware Ghost Protocol (kiosk gated off by `acc_cyberware_on`, unreachable in dev), and all
this-session script changes â€” none touch targeting. GSC + full geometry build.

  emitted the buyable-door entities **top-level**, but its old `strip()` only removed single-level **leaf**

  brushes inside worldspawn, top-level door/light entities, **and** orphaned shells â€” keeping worldspawn and
  re-emitting exactly **one** trigger + **one** slab (verified: 1 / 1, no `_dupe`). The de-dupe is now a no-op.
- **Redesign: enclosed staircase, not a railed pit.** The "big block" was the well's 128u opaque railing
  ring around an open pit dropped into a 360Ã—300 room. v2 **enlarges the Implant Lab WEST** to x[-720,-40]
  ([`gen_plaza_shrink.js`](tools/gen_plaza_shrink.js): west wall -400â†’-720, north wall extended; benches +
  doorway unchanged, self-check clean) and rebuilds the descent as an **enclosed staircase room** in the new
  SW corner: the stairwell well (now x[-720,-496], flush against the west wall) is wrapped in **full-height
  (z[0,256]) N/S walls + a doorway on the EAST face** so it reads as a basement stairwell. The vault extends
  west (x[-720,300]) to meet the stair bottom; stations unchanged. Door origin â†’ `(-496,-376,50)`; OOB

### Fixed â€” Deep audit: all 7 confirmed co-op bugs (user, 2026-06-27)

A 10-cluster adversarial code/doc audit (52 modules, 22 agents) surfaced 7 confirmed bugs (5 plausible findings
were refuted as unreachable). **All 7 are now fixed** â€” the 4 clean ones first, then the 3 balance/scope ones:

- **Glitch Purge HUD hudelem leak (high)** â€” `hud::createBar` allocates 3 hudelems (bar, **frame**, bg) but
  `_acc_lockdown_challenge::destroy_challenge_hud` only freed `.bar` + the handle, leaking the **`barFrame`** per
  inside-player **per purge**, permanently starving the shared co-op HUD pool (the documented ~96-elem ceiling).
  **Fix:** the purge bar is now a single `hud::createIcon("white",â€¦)` width-scaled by progress (the squad-roster
  idiom) â€” 1 hudelem instead of 3, and no `barFrame` to leak. Also freed the same leaked `barFrame` in
  [_acc_health_bars.gsc](scripts/zm/zm_abandoned_cyber_city/_acc_health_bars.gsc) `make_player_bar` (rare rebuild path).
- **Trench Warden permanently suppressed (high/softlock)** â€” `_acc_boss.gsc::run_mini_boss` carried
  `level endon("acc_round_end")` and set `level.acc_brutus_active = true` before the spawn telegraph; a fast co-op
  round ending mid-telegraph tore the thread down before the flag was cleared / death-watch attached â†’ Brutus
  **never respawned all match**. **Fix:** dropped the round-scoped endon (Brutus roams across rounds via
  `ignore_enemy_count`), so the cleanup + death-watch always run.
- **Paradise gate could open for free (economy)** â€” `_acc_abyss_doors.gsc::hub_door_loop` debited the shared
  Points pool by `give_p` unconditionally, but stock `minus_to_player_score` charges nothing under **Shopping
  Free Gobblegum** / `intermission`. **Fix:** debit the pool by the **actual** `score` delta (mirrors the shards
  branch). Now you can't drain the communal gate cost without spending.
- **Paradise Phantom reward farm (balance)** â€” `_acc_boss_phantom::phantom_death_watch` granted the full
  guaranteed reward set (item + Mega Bottle + shards to every player) on **every** kill, ungated â€” so the
  survive-don't-farm finale (up to 4 Phantoms cycling) became a loot piÃ±ata. **Fix:** the reward block is now
  gated on `!level.acc_paradise_onslaught` (the corpse-cleanup + host-clear still always run), mirroring the
  reward-free Paradise Brutus path and `block_powerup_drop`.
- **Boss-item drop denied to teammates (co-op)** â€” `_acc_boss_items::on_boss_death` converted the roll to shards
  and `return`ed when the **killer** already owned the item, spawning **no** pickup â€” so a teammate who lacked it
  got nothing. **Fix:** always `spawn_pickup` (like `grant_challenge_reward`); `watch_pickup`'s per-grabber dedupe
  still converts the killer's own duplicate to shards if they grab it.
- **Late-join boss bar (cosmetic)** â€” `_acc_health_bars::boss_bar_track` snapshotted the player set once at boss
  spawn, so a mid-fight joiner never saw the bar. **Fix:** reconcile against `GetPlayers()` each tick and lazily
  add a set for any untracked player (dedup by `s.player`, so existing players are never re-created = no HUD spam).

GSC-only; lint-clean; build OK.

### Added â€” "The Exchange": a player-to-player transfer vault under the Plaza (user, 2026-06-27)

A new room where players **transfer resources to each other** â€” Points, Data Shards, Mega Bottles, and
Boss Items. Reached by a **stairwell carved DOWN from the Implant Lab** into an enclosed vault at **z=-240
directly under the spawn Plaza**, gated by a buyable slide-up door (`enter_exchange`, 1500 pts). Full design:
[docs/58_transfer_vault.md](docs/58_transfer_vault.md).

- **Model = SHARED TEAM VAULT** (user's choice over directed-give / two-pad): deposit into a level-side team
  pool, **any teammate withdraws** â€” no player-targeting (sidesteps the `closest_player_override` co-op
  hazards). Co-op redistribution of the strictly per-player economy (docs/15); a personal stash in solo.
- **Module** [`_acc_transfer.gsc`](scripts/zm/zm_abandoned_cyber_city/_acc_transfer.gsc) (new, orchestrated
  by `_acc_main` after data_shards/mega_bottles/boss_items; `scriptparsetree` added to the `.zone`). Four
  script-spawned terminals (no LED-bake cost), each with a **DEPOSIT** + **WITHDRAW** pad (one trigger per
  action â€” the Implant-Bench multi-pad idiom). Each press moves one fixed increment (`acc_vault_points_inc`
  250 / `acc_vault_shards_inc` 25 / 1 bottle / 1 item; locker caps at `acc_vault_items_max` 8). **A 10%
  deposit tax** (`acc_vault_tax_pct`, user 2026-06-27) applies to **Points + Data Shards** only â€” the pool
  receives ~90% of a deposit (the cut is destroyed); **Bottles + Items are untaxed** â€” so a team can't
  trivially funnel the whole economy onto one player. Currency
  uses the documented APIs (`zm_score::minus_/add_to_player_score` â€” never writes `player.score`;
  `acc_data_shards::try_spend`/`grant_player(â€¦,"transfer")` so withdraw deducts by what actually landed under
  the cap; `try_consume_bottle`/`grant_bottle`). Boss-item deposit can **un-implant** a slot (runs
  `on_unequip` â†’ buff off, speed recomputed); withdraw drops it into the carry slot (enable at a bench).
  Hints are constant (250-hint cap); amounts + pool show via `hud_msg`. Both ends gate on `is_player_valid`.
- **Geometry** [`tools/gen_plaza_basement.js`](tools/gen_plaza_basement.js) (new, re-runnable + `--revert`):
  **carves** the single stock arena-floor slab (`{219830C1â€¦}`) into a connected 4-chunk frame around a
  stairwell well (the abyss strip-and-re-emit pattern â€” the only way to hole a solid slab), + a 14-tread
  16/16 stairwell, the enclosed vault room (carved floor = its ceiling), a jump-proof railing ring, and the
  door slab. Bake-safe `box()` filler-winding + a **unique `7A2BAE0*` GUID prefix** (NOT the `-ACE0-` middle
  group â€” the abyss family already uses `{7A2BAB0E-ACE0-â€¦}`, so stripping on `-ACE0-` would have deleted 23
  abyss brushes; bug caught + fixed during the build). **LED bake: BAKED** (`tools/_bake_test.ps1`); full
  `build_map.ps1` OK, fresh 46 MB `.ff`, navmesh regenerated over the stairs.
- **Fix (user 2026-06-27): the well was walling off the Implant Bench room.** First placement put the well
  (and its north railing) right behind the plazaâ†’lab doorway, so buying the implant door led straight into a

Recurring hard crash, reproduced **during normal play** (not at an interaction). This is a **DIFFERENT BG-cache
pool** from the 2026-06-25 soul-box fix: that one was `triggerstring` (cap **250**, fed by `SetHintString`); this
one is the general **`string` cache (cap 2048**, fed by every DISTINCT string passed to a server hudelem
`SetText`). Like the triggerstring cache, every distinct string **permanently burns a slot for the whole match**
(never freed). A live number rendered via **`SetValue` costs ZERO slots** (stock `_zm.gsc` `countdown_hud SetValue`)
â€” that is the cache-free path the old code never used (it only mentioned `SetValue` in a comment).

**THE crash â€” co-op squad roster** ([_acc_health_bars.gsc](scripts/zm/zm_abandoned_cyber_city/_acc_health_bars.gsc)):
`update_roster` ran **10Ã—/sec per player** and `SetText`'d one merged line `"Sh "+shards+...+"$"+points` with
**no change-guard**. `points` (= live `.score`) takes **thousands of distinct values** over a match â†’ thousands
of permanent `string`-cache slots â†’ overflow at 2048. Because the roster is *always running*, it crashed during
normal play rather than at a specific interaction (unlike the soul boxes). Fix = **two elements that render as
one flush string** `"Sh {shards}  MB {b}  EXO {e}  $<points>"`: the text part (`Sh`/shards/`MB`/`EXO`/`$`, or
`"DOWNED  $"`) is a **`SetText` element RIGHT-aligned to end exactly at the `$`** (change-guarded), and the only
truly-unbounded field, **`points`** (= live `.score`), is a **`SetValue` element LEFT-aligned 2px after it** â€”
so the `$` sits flush against the score every frame. A number via `SetValue` costs **zero** cache slots, so the
climbing score can never overflow the 2048 cap again. shards/MB/EXO remain in `SetText` because they're a small
**bounded** set (shards is a spend-capped currency â€” it was the stable pre-roster top-left readout), not a runaway
like the score. Cost: **+1 hudelem/row** (3â†’4; lazy, so 4-player = 16, still well under the old 24 that blew the
pool). *(Two earlier attempts were reverted: a 3-column `SetValue` layout â€” user rejected it for dropping the
`Sh`/`$` labels and widening gaps; then `.label` + `SetValue` â€” **`.label` does NOT draw on `createFontString`
server hudelems** (verified in-game: only the bare number rendered, all prefix text vanished). The right-aligned
`SetText` is the reliable way to keep a text prefix on a flush, crash-safe number.)*

**Two more `SetText` offenders hardened** (both â†’ `SetValue`): the hidden top-left **Data-Shards counter**
([_acc_data_shards.gsc:360](scripts/zm/zm_abandoned_cyber_city/_acc_data_shards.gsc#L360), high-cardinality), and
the **round counter** ([_acc_health_bars.gsc:106](scripts/zm/zm_abandoned_cyber_city/_acc_health_bars.gsc#L106),
bounded â‰¤255 but the correct cache-free path). **Key correction:** `alpha = 0` (hidden) does **NOT** stop `SetText`
registering a string â€” registration happens on the *call*, regardless of visibility â€” so the hidden shard counter
was still leaking.

A full-repo audit (6-tool sweep) confirmed **no other unbounded** feeder: the Paradise finale timer (~240 distinct
`M:SS` strings, **one-shot** end-game) and lockdown `killed/total` counter (â‰¤~30/challenge, totals reused) are
**bounded-small** and left as-is; all `SetHintString` callers are bounded or already change-guarded; **no**
`PrecacheString` anywhere; LUI `setText` uses a separate pool. Rule (extends the soul-box rule to this cache):
**never `SetText` a live/unbounded number â€” use `SetValue`; a hidden element still burns the slot.** Built clean
(GSC-only, fresh `.ff` 46 MB). Docs: [49_hud_modernization.md](docs/49_hud_modernization.md). Memory:
`string-cache-setvalue-not-settext`.

Paladin headshots were doing **half a body shot**. Root cause: the damage code applies a universal headshot

but the Paladin's `skye_t8_paladin_hb50.gdt` had `locHead`/`locHelmet` flattened to **1.0** (1.0 Ã— 0.5 = **0.5Ã—
body**) â€” an old "all-1.0" Paladin pass had been re-applied on this box. (Both loc tools, `normalize_gun_loc.js`
and the older `normalize_sniper_loc.js`, actually set snipers to head 5.0; the MORS was already correct at 5.0 â€”
only the Paladin had regressed. It's a known recurring regression, see the memory.)

### Fixed â€” Phantom only damaged one player in co-op + HP âˆ’30% (user, 2026-06-26)

The Phantom **sapped (slowed) every player on its chain but only ever damaged one** in co-op. Two separate damage
paths were both broken; both fixed:

- **Normal melee â€” stale AI enemy** ([_acc_boss_phantom.gsc](scripts/zm/zm_abandoned_cyber_city/_acc_boss_phantom.gsc)):
  the Phantom deals normal damage via the **stock zombie AI melee** (`host.meleeDamage`), but it never told the AI
  who to hit â€” so the AI held one acquired `self.enemy` and the blinks onto other players never connected a swing.
  **Fix:** `host.closest_player_override = &phantom_pick_target_override`, which returns the Phantom's **current
  blink target** (updated every blink in `phantom_blink_to`). Stock `get_closest_valid_player` consults this per-AI
  override (`_zm_utility.gsc:1474`) to set **both** `self.favoriteenemy` (movement) and `self.enemy` (melee), so the
  AI now chases + swings at whoever the Phantom just warped onto, rotating across the team. Same mechanism the
  Glitch Stalker uses.
- **Chain special â€” sapped but didn't damage** (the exact symptom): the chain applies its **slow directly** to each
  hop player, but relied on the AI for *damage* â€” and the 0.7â€“1.1s rapid hops never give the AI a swing, so only its
  one enemy took damage. **Fix:** the chain now also deals the per-hop hit **directly** via
  `target DoDamage(meleeDmg, â€¦, "MOD_MELEE")` â€” the same means-of-death as a stock zombie melee, so Jugg / Exo /
  trench scaling / downing all apply (`_acc_elites::on_player_damaged`). Now the chain damages **each** player it
  saps.
- **Chain reaches all 4**: `ACC_PHANTOM_CHAIN_HOPS_DEF` 3 â†’ **4** (still capped to the live player count), so a
  4-player chain hits everyone, not 3 of 4.
- **HP âˆ’30%, scaling preserved**: `ACC_PHANTOM_HP` 80000 â†’ **56000** (solo) Ã— the unchanged logarithmic
  `boss_hp_player_mult()` â†’ solo 56k / 2p 84k / 3p ~100k / 4p 112k (was 80k/120k/143k/160k). Pure GSC â€” linker-only.

### Fixed â€” Phantom override could hang the server in co-op (audit, 2026-06-26)

Follow-up from a 6-dimension adversarial audit of the Phantom (19 raw findings â†’ 1 confirmed, 18 refuted). The
`closest_player_override` melee fix above had a **reachable co-op server-hang**: `phantom_pick_target_override`
returned `self.acc_phantom_target` gated only on `acc_data_shards::is_player_alive` (no `.ignoreme` check), but
stock `get_closest_valid_player` (`_zm_utility.gsc`) pre-culls its `players` array to `am_i_valid` entries
(**which includes `.ignoreme`**) and then re-checks the returned player in a **wait-less** loop,
`ArrayRemoveValue`-ing invalid ones. If the Phantom's target was a teammate cloaked by **Cyberware Ghost
Protocol** (`rx2b` â†’ `zm_utility::increment_ignoreme`, who stays alive + standing so `is_player_alive` passes),
stock's `ArrayRemoveValue` was a no-op, `players.size` never hit 0, and the override handed back the same player
every iteration â†’ **infinite loop on the AI targeting frame** (server hang). Needs â‰¥2 players (the cloaked target
+ one still-valid teammate). **Fix** ([_acc_boss_phantom.gsc](scripts/zm/zm_abandoned_cyber_city/_acc_boss_phantom.gsc)):
membership-check `acc_phantom_target` against the passed-in `players` array before returning it (mirrors the
Glitch Stalker's `glitch_pick_uncloaked_target`, which only ever returns a member of the validated set);
otherwise fall through to the path-distance / closest fallback. Pure GSC â€” linker-only.

### Fixed â€” Mahem "only packs twice" â€” the REAL cause: AAT exemption hides the machine (user, 2026-06-26)

The Mahem could PaP only **twice** despite several prior fixes. **Those fixes were all wrong** â€” they patched
`level.zombie_weapons_upgraded` (the upgrade table), but that was never broken. Full trace through stock
`_zm_pack_a_punch.gsc` + `aat_shared.gsc` + `_zm_weapons.gsc`:

- After the tier-2 transform you hold `s1_mahem_up`. For pack 3 the machine must stay **visible**.
  `player_use_can_pack_now()` shows it only if `can_pack_weapon(held) || weapon_supports_aat(held)`.
- `can_pack_weapon(_up)` is **false for every gun** â€” `is_weapon_included(_up)` fails because stock
  `add_zombie_weapon` registers only the BASE in `level.zombie_weapons`, never the `_up`. So **all** guns rely on
  **`weapon_supports_aat(_up)`** for the tier-2â†’3 visibility: `is_weapon_upgraded(root) && !aat::is_exempt_weapon`.
- `is_weapon_upgraded(s1_mahem_up)` was **already true** (stock `add_zombie_weapon:554` maps every CSV upgrade) â€”
  so the upgrade-table patches were no-ops. **The real blocker:** the Mahem's CSV row has **`AAT_EXEMPT` (col 17)
  = `TRUE`** (it's a launcher) â†’ `register_aat_exemption(s1_mahem_up)` â†’ `weapon_supports_aat` returns false â†’
  **machine hides the instant pack 2 finishes.** Conventional guns leave that column blank, so they pack 3Ã—.
- **Fix** ([_acc_pap_levels.gsc](scripts/zm/zm_abandoned_cyber_city/_acc_pap_levels.gsc)
  `make_mahem_pap_visible_to_tier3()`, called from `pap_tier_machine_watcher`): drop `s1_mahem_up` from
  `level.aat_exemptions`. AAT is globally OFF (`level.aat_in_use=false`), so this grants **no** alt-ammo â€” it only
  restores machine visibility so `acc_pap_validate` (which `vending_weapon_upgrade` calls first, before any AAT
  branch) runs the in-place tier-3 pack, exactly like every conventional `_up` gun.
- The earlier `register_special_upgrades()` is kept (harmless defensive net) but its comment is corrected â€” it was
  never the Mahem fix. Dev log prints `was_aat_exempt=1 is_weapon_upgraded=1`; `+set acc_dev 1` then shows the 3rd
  pack reach `tier 3/3`. Pure GSC â€” linker-only. docs/05 + memory updated.
- **Belt-and-suspenders (this build):** pack 3 has TWO independent gates â€” machine **visibility** (above) AND the
  **tier key** resolving `s1_mahem_up`â†’`s1_mahem` (so `get_tier` reads the tier stored on packs 1â€‘2). Hardened the
  latter too: `_acc_weapon_variants::true_base()` now strips a trailing `_up` by NAME if the stock upgrade table
  didn't, so the tier key is always the true base regardless of stock-table state (no-op for conventional guns).
  Added an `acc_dev` ground-truth readout `dev_mahem_pap_watch()` that prints, whenever you hold a Mahem,
  `upg= base= tier= exempt= machine_visible=` â€” so any remaining issue is diagnosable at a glance instead of guessed.
